jobs.title: Fabrication & Project Coordinator, Computer 3-d/2-d drafting — Seed Design & Build
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Fabrication \& Project Coordinator specializing in Computer\-Aided Design (CAD) 3D/2D drafting to join our innovative design and build team. In this role, you will be the key driver behind translating conceptual ideas into precise fabrication drawings and project plans, ensuring seamless coordination between design, engineering, and fabrication teams. Your expertise will help bring complex projects to life through meticulous drafting, modeling, and documentation, all while maintaining a vibrant, energetic workflow that propels projects forward. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting\-edge design\-build projects, utilizing advanced CAD software and building information modeling (BIM) tools to deliver exceptional results.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop detailed 3D models and 2D drawings using CAD software such as AutoCAD, Revit, MicroStation, or SolidWorks for fabrication and construction purposes
* Collaborate closely with project managers, engineers, and fabricators to ensure design intent is accurately translated into fabrication\-ready schematics and documentation
* Utilize BIM tools like Revit and NavisWorks to coordinate project models, identify clashes, and streamline construction workflows
* Create precise schematics, mechanical drafting, and CAD documentation that adhere to project specifications and industry standards
* Assist in the development of construction sequences by producing 2D animations or visualizations for client presentations and internal reviews
* Maintain organized CAD files, version control, and project records to ensure easy access and seamless updates throughout project lifecycle
* Support fabrication teams by providing clear technical drawings, assembly instructions, and mechanical design details necessary for manufacturing

**Experience**

* Proven experience with CAD software including AutoCAD, SketchUp, NavisWorks, Civil 3D, MicroStation, SolidWorks, Revit or similar platforms
* Strong background in mechanical drafting and engineering CAD design within construction or fabrication environments
* Familiarity with building information modeling (BIM) tools for integrated project coordination
* Knowledge of schematics creation, CAD detailing, mechanical design processes, and construction documentation standards
* Hands\-on experience with 3D CAD modeling and 2D animation techniques for visualizing complex projects
* Prior involvement in construction projects or fabrication workflows that require detailed drafting and technical precision
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and schematics accurately while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams

Join us to be part of a vibrant team dedicated to transforming innovative ideas into tangible realities! This role is perfect for passionate professionals eager to leverage their CAD expertise in a fast\-paced environment that values creativity, precision, and teamwork.

Pay: $40,000\.00 \- $45,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Construction Project Coordinator**

Position Summary

**Who We Are**

D\&H Contractors builds and renovates homes on the Westside of Los Angeles. Brentwood, Bel Air, Pacific Palisades, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills. Our projects are large, detailed, and held to a standard our clients can see every day, because they live in them.

We are a family\-oriented general contracting company. Our team is small enough that every person here has a direct hand in the finished result, and no one’s work disappears into a process. We are growing, and we intend to grow with the people we hire.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented **Construction Project Coordinator** to support residential construction projects throughout Los Angeles.

The people who do well here take ownership without being asked twice. They catch the detail that is off before the client does. They follow up, answer the phone, and raise a problem early rather than hoping it resolves itself. They care what the finished work looks like.

If you want a role where your judgment matters and your work is visible, this is the role.

This position requires both office and field work. The ideal candidate will regularly visit job sites, review construction drawings, coordinate with contractors and vendors, order construction materials, and help keep projects on schedule and within budget. What You Will Do

* Support the project team across multiple residential construction and development projects simultaneously.
* Visit job sites regularly to track progress and confirm work is being built to plan and specification.
* Read and interpret architectural, structural, MEP, and shop drawings.
* Prepare material take\-offs from drawings and place material orders.
* Ensure materials are ordered and delivered according to the construction schedule.
* Coordinate with our subcontractors, architects, engineers, inspectors, and city agencies.
* Track schedules, RFIs, submittals, change orders, inspections, and punch lists.
* Attend site meetings and follow up on outstanding action items.
* Verify completed work complies with project drawings and quality standards.
* Source quotes from vendors and subcontractors, review invoices, purchase orders, and contractor payment requests.
* Keep project documentation, permits, and reports organized and up to date.
* Perform additional project\-related duties as assigned.

**What You Bring**

* Two or more years in construction coordination, project coordination, or assistant project management
* Ability to read and understand construction drawings. This is not negotiable.
* Working knowledge of LADBS \& permitting process, OSHA regulations, and Southern California construction codes.
* Experience coordinating with contractors, vendors, and suppliers.
* Strong organization, clear communication, and the instinct to solve a problem rather than pass it along.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proficient in Google Workspace (docs, Sheets, slides, etc.)
* Experience with Bluebeam, Procore, AutoCAD, or similar construction software is a plus.
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Willingness to travel to construction sites throughout the Los Angeles metro area.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.

**Helpful, Not Required**

* Experience on high\-end residential renovation, custom homes, or additions
* Experience performing material take\-offs and ordering materials from drawings
* Familiarity with Bluebeam, Procore, AutoCad, Houzz Pro, or similar construction software.
* Purchasing and procurement experience.

This position offers the opportunity for long\-term growth. Compensation is based on experience.

Work Location: In person

**How To Apply**

Send your resume to , along with a short note about a project you are proud of and your role in it. We read them.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
#### **Reports to – Senior Program Manager**


#### **Organization Overview**


Baby2Baby is a non\-profit organization that provides children in need with diapers, formula, clothing, and the basic necessities that every child deserves, serving more than one million children across all 50 states. Over the past 15 years, Baby2Baby has distributed over half a billion items to children in homeless shelters, domestic violence programs, foster care, hospitals and school districts as well as children who have lost everything in the wake of disaster. The organization’s success has been propelled forward by it’s industry\-leading model that is redefining what it means to operate a nonprofit with a seamless integration of impact, innovation, and influence, which earned them praise from TIME Magazine as one of 2023’s most influential companies and recognition as the \#1 nonprofit on Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies List.


#### **Position Overview**


Reporting to the Senior Manager, Program, the Program Coordinator, will support the coordination of distributing essential items to partner organizations across the western region. This role is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operations by maintaining databases, processing donation requests, and coordinating item distribution logistics.The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment.


The Program Coordinator will work at Baby2Baby’s HQ. The work is performed in an office setting and is currently on site 3\-5 days per week with potential visits to partner organizations.


#### **Duties and Responsibilities**


* Serves as a key liaison for partner organizations, managing communications and providing support.
* Collects donation requests from partner organizations, synthesizes needs, and enters data into Baby2Baby’s warehouse management system to help facilitate accurate and timely distribution.
* Maintains and updates partner databases, ensuring accurate tracking of organization and contact information.
* Coordinates enrollment for specialized bundle programs, working with internal departments and partner organizations.
* Monitors current events and news to contribute to the weekly news report, helping the team stay informed on emerging issues affecting the communities we serve.
* Supports Senior Program Manager with researching and vetting new partner organizations.
* Participates in and coordinates orientations for new partners on Baby2Baby programs and procedures.
* Participates in the execution of regular in\-person distribution days along with community site visits.
* Supports development and programmatic events such as annual distributions and volunteer sessions, as needed.
* Performs additional duties as assigned.

#### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* 2 or more years of experience in a program support, operations, or a related role.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and maintain accuracy.
* Strong organizational skills with a key attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and Google Sheets.
* Strong commitment to Baby2Baby’s mission and values.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Conversational Spanish language skills.

#### **Salary**

This role’s salary range is between $24\-$26/hr. Actual salary is determined based on a number of factors, including but not limited to your relevant skills, qualifications, and years of experience.


#### **Other**


**Baby2Baby is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering diversity within its staff.** We have made diverse thinking a priority in order to keep our organization in touch with the needs of families in our program and to help hold us accountable to those we serve. Our organization strives for diversity, from the children we serve to our board and staff, not only in race, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, and religion but also in cultural background and life experiences.

**Growth Opportunity:** This position is intended to grow into a full\-time role as UFIT’s programs and operational needs expand. The timing of the transition will be based on organizational growth, workload, and the coordinator’s demonstrated performance and reliability.

 **About UFIT**



UFIT provides structured sports, physical education, and youth development programs for schools and community partners throughout Los Angeles County. Our programs combine physical activity, skill development, social\-emotional learning, and exposure to college and career pathways through sports.



We are seeking an organized, resourceful Program Operations Coordinator who can keep our programs, communications, marketing, and internal systems moving forward. This is a hands\-on coordination role for someone who follows through, catches details, uses technology confidently, and does not need constant supervision.

 **Position Overview**



The Program Operations Coordinator will support the Founder and work closely with UFIT’s recruitment and field leadership team. This person will coordinate operational tasks, maintain accurate systems and records, manage administrative follow\-up, and ensure UFIT’s marketing communications are consistently prepared and published.



This role will begin part\-time and is expected to develop into a full\-time position as UFIT expands. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the organization, take on greater responsibility over time, and help build the operational structure needed to support that growth.



The right candidate knows how to use AI and automation to work efficiently—but also understands that technology does not replace accuracy, judgment, quality control, or personal accountability.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

Program Operations


* Maintain program calendars, deadlines, school information, staffing records, and operational trackers.
* Coordinate administrative details for new and existing school programs.
* Prepare and organize program documents, quotes, schedules, reports, and internal communications.
* Track assignments, approvals, missing information, and follow\-up items through completion.
* Support communication between UFIT administration, school partners, coaches, and program leadership.
* Review documents and systems for accuracy before information is distributed.
* Provide the Founder with clear updates on completed work, pending decisions, and potential problems.

  



Marketing and Communications


* Maintain UFIT’s social media, email marketing, and outreach calendar.
* Use AI\-supported tools to create first drafts of emails, graphics, captions, flyers, and campaign content.

* Adapt UFIT’s messaging for schools, families, coaches, community partners, and prospective clients.
* Monitor basic campaign results, including opens, clicks, responses, and engagement.
* Keep marketing materials current, professional, and aligned with UFIT’s brand.
* Maintain organized folders containing approved graphics, videos, templates, and campaign materials.

  



Systems and Administrative Coordination


* Maintain accurate information across Google Workspace, BambooHR, the training platform, CRM/email marketing tools, and other UFIT systems.
* Support employee onboarding documentation and ensure required information is entered correctly.
* Verify that automated forms, emails, workflows, and integrations are functioning as intended.
* Identify duplicate, outdated, missing, or incorrectly filed information.
* Coordinate software issues with the appropriate vendor or developer and track them until resolved.
* Research practical AI tools and automations that can reduce repetitive administrative work.
* Create and maintain straightforward procedures for recurring operational tasks.

  


**What This Position Is Not**



This position is not responsible for recruiting coaches, directly training the coaching staff, supervising daily school\-site performance, developing software, or independently changing UFIT policies. The coordinator supports these functions by keeping the information, systems, communications, and follow\-up organized.

* At least three years of experience in operations, project coordination, executive support, program administration, or a similar position.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple deadlines and assignments without losing track of details.

* Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity and content development.

* Ability to handle employee and business information confidentially.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**



Under the general supervision of the Director of Community Engagement and Center Principal Investigator, the Community Engagement Program Coordinator will be responsible for developing and maintaining community engagement programs, initiatives, and resources that advance the Center’s mission and goals.



About the Center:



The Charles R. Drew University of Medicine and Science (CDU) Center for Accelerating Excellence in Translational Science (AXIS) has focused on eliminating health disparities in the south Los Angeles community, particularly those related to cancer, cardiometabolic diseases, and HIV/AIDS. As an unexpected expansion in response to the needs of our local community, the entire CDU establishment also led community initiatives to improve local outcomes during the pandemic, including providing education and facilitating screening, prevention, care, and clinical trials.

  


**Essential Duties**


* Develop and Maintain community engagement programs, initiatives, and resources that advance the Center’s mission and goals
* Work with internal and external partners to identify opportunities for collaboration and resource sharing
* Serve as a liaison between the Center and various communities, promoting positive relationships and open communication
* Promote the Center’s research projects (Full, Pilot, and Supplements) to community physicians, health care providers, potential study candidates, community\-based organizations, research organizations, the CDU community, and other locations or groups
* Manage community engagement and outreach events and campaigns, including planning, logistics, budgeting, and execution of monthly and annual conferences.
* Develop marketing and promotional materials for community engagement initiatives that include social media
* Write grants and proposals to secure funding for community engagement programs
* Train and supervise staff and volunteers working on community engagement projects (i.e. Clinical Trials Education)
* Collect data and feedback from participants in community engagement programs to assess effectiveness and make necessary improvements
* Keep abreast of trends and developments in the field of community engagement and share relevant information with staff and other stakeholders
* Attend community meetings, health fairs, and events as needed to represent the Center

* At least 2 years or more years of experience working in an academic setting or institution with responsibility for coordinating educational programs and activities.
* At least 2 or more years of experience in scientific and programmatic grant development, writing, and submission of grant proposals and reports to federal, local, and private funding agencies.
* Experience in the coordination of staff and students, including experience working in conjunction with HR. Also strongly prefer experience working with diverse partners and cultural sensitivity.

jobs.title: Community Outreach Ambassador
jobs.description:
#### **ABH Riverside**

#### **Job Summary:**


The Outreach Ambassador – Homeless Services is a dynamic, field\-based role at Weingart Center, a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to ending homelessness in Los Angeles. This position blends community programming with direct outreach to individuals experiencing homelessness. Ambassadors facilitate wellness and educational activities for interim housing residents, while also engaging unhoused individuals in surrounding public areas. They work closely with LAHSA, LA County outreach teams, and site security to connect individuals to housing and support services. The role includes food distribution, documentation, caseload support, and assistance to the Program Manager in daily operations.


#### **Essential Functions:**


Conduct daily outreach in public areas, accompanied by site security, to engage unhoused individuals respectfully and safely



Walk designated routes with a clipboard to document interactions, needs, and housing interest



Complete intakes and assessments, and connect individuals to housing resources through LAHSA and partner agencies



Collaborate with LA County outreach coordinators to coordinate referrals and follow\-ups



Maintain an active caseload of 10–15 individuals, including both interim housing residents and outreach contacts



Conduct regular check\-ins to assess progress, update housing plans, and identify barriers to stability



Track client milestones such as document readiness, housing application status, and service referrals



Develop and lead monthly activity calendars (e.g., workshops, fitness, arts, life skills) for interim housing residents



Promote participation through flyers, announcements, and one\-on\-one engagement



Organize and distribute meals/snacks to residents and outreach contacts



Track food inventory and coordinate with vendors and volunteers for safe delivery



Maintain accurate case notes and documentation in HMIS/Clarity



Assist the Program Manager with administrative tasks, reporting, and coordination



Uphold trauma\-informed, harm\-reduction, and culturally competent practices in all interactions


#### **Required Qualifications:**


High school diploma or equivalent (Associate or Bachelor’s in social work, psychology, or related field preferred)



1–2 years of experience in outreach, social services, or activity coordination



Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage in diverse populations



Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, mental health challenges, or substance use preferred



Must be empathetic, observant, and able to advocate effectively



Food service training or certification required (e.g., ServSafe or equivalent)



CPR/First Aid certification (or willingness to obtain)



Willingness to complete training in Trauma\-Informed Care, De\-escalation, and Harm Reduction


#### **Physical \& Mental Requirements:**


Ability to walk long distances and stand for extended periods while conducting outreach



Capable of lifting up to 25 lbs. and performing physical tasks such as bending, reaching, and carrying supplies



Strong verbal communication, reading, writing, and decision\-making skills



Comfortable working indoors, outdoors, and in diverse urban environments



Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with face\-to\-face and verbal contact


#### **About WEINGART CENTER ASSOCIATION**


As one of the best comprehensive human services organizations in the western United States, Weingart Center is committed to removing barriers that keep people from housing. With multiple Interim and Permanent Supportive Housing solutions throughout the greater Los Angeles area, Weingart Center addresses the needs of seniors, Veterans, women, members of the LGBTQAI\+ community, the formerly incarcerated, and many others experiencing homelessness. All Weingart Center housing solutions include comprehensive wraparound services, which are designed to help clients overcome challenges and clear the way for a fulfilling life.

At Griffith Company, we recognize that people are our most valuable resource. We nurture that resource by fostering a work environment that encourages communication, respect and recognition. In this environment, Griffith Company employees flourish, taking their careers to new levels. In addition to offering a 120 year history of quality, safety and excellence, Griffith Company has a dynamic, exciting and supportive culture where opportunity for growth abounds.

**POSITION PURPOSE**  

The Marketing Coordinator create visual materials that support Griffith Company Business Development (digital and print) as well as various company division/departments. This position will work directly under supervision of the Business Development Manager to help integrated branded campaigns, produce ongoing website updates, support various ranging company graphics needs (i.e., Awards, qualification packages, Ads), produce visual content for digital social media posts, manage photo libraries, and help maintain company branding guidelines across Griffith’s many divisions.

* Strong understanding of typography, color theory, scale, and layout.

* Strong organizational and file\-management skills.
* Proficiency in photography and photo\-editing experience
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office PowerPoint, Teams, Word, Outlook, and Adobe Acrobat.
* Working knowledge of print production and digital file preparation.
* Self\-directed work style with the initiative to move projects forward.

* Familiarity with website content management systems preferred.

Preparing availability reports for international and domestic distributors/broadcasters.

Collecting royalty statements and logging payments in our digital system.

* Fluency in at least one foreign language helpful.
* A strong love of international travel and social environments.
* A born seller and hustler. Ambitious and self\-directed.

jobs.title: Procurement Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job no:** 561449  

**Work type:** Staff  

**Location:** Pomona  

**Categories:** Unit 7 \- CSUEU \- Clerical and Administrative Support Services, Administrative, Temporary, Full Time, On\-site (work in\-person at business location)  

**Type of Appointment:** Full Time, Long\-Term Temporary  

  

**Job Classification:** Administrative Support Coordinator I  

  

**Anticipated Hiring Range:** $4,047 \- $4,128 per month  

  

**Work Schedule:** Monday\-Friday, 8am\-5pm  

  

**THE DEPARTMENT:**  

  

The primary function of the Procurement Services Department is to purchase goods and services through collaborative approaches, by leveraging spend and managing suppliers to optimize costs, improve supplier performance, and lowering risk for University requirements. This includes ensuring that the University complies with all contract rules and laws, as established by the government, including State of California and the Chancellor's Office.  

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**



Procurement Systems \& Requisition Support


* Enter, process, monitor, and track requisitions and related procurement transactions in PeopleSoft, CSU Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Smartsheet, and other applicable procurement systems.
* Provide administrative support for purchase order processing, including tracking transaction status, maintaining supporting documentation, and coordinating routine follow\-up with Buyers, Leads, campus departments, and vendors.
* Review procurement submissions and supporting documents for administrative completeness, identify missing information or documentation, and route matters requiring procurement judgment or subject\-matter review to the appropriate Buyer, Lead, Manager, Accounts Payable, or other responsible area.
* Maintain organized, accurate, and audit\-ready procurement records in established shared repositories, including requisitions, purchase orders, insurance documentation, correspondence, and related transaction records.
* Support P2P users and suppliers with routine system, process, transaction\-status, and documentation questions, including routing or escalating issues outside the coordinator's area of responsibility.
* Run queries, maintain tracking tools, and prepare routine operational reports and status information for Procurement leadership, Leads, and Buyers.


Office \& Customer Service Support


* Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for Procurement Services and respond to routine campus and vendor inquiries by phone, email, and other established communication channels.
* Research routine procurement\-related questions and provide established procedural information, referring matters requiring Buyer, Lead, Manager, Accounts Payable, or other subject\-matter ownership as appropriate.
* Receive, review, distribute, and follow up on incoming Procurement Services mail and documentation to ensure items requiring filing, tracking, or action are appropriately completed.
* Receive and file Certificates of Insurance and other insurance documentation in the established Procurement SharePoint repository using applicable filing and naming conventions.
* Maintain organized electronic records and shared files so supporting documentation can be readily located by authorized staff.
* Provide customer service and administrative follow\-through on Procurement inquiries while maintaining professional and timely communication.


Administrative \& Leadership Support


* Provide administrative coordination and operational support to the Procurement Director, Manager, Leads, and Buyers.
* Prepare and distribute routine correspondence, documents, reports, and other administrative materials.
* Track administrative requests, assignments, and supporting documentation through completion.
* Assist with maintaining department records, shared resources, procedures, and reference materials.


Meeting \& Project Coordination


* Schedule and coordinate meetings for procurement leadership and teams.
* Schedule and coordinate Procurement meetings, trainings, demonstrations, and project activities.
* Prepare agendas and supporting materials, take meeting notes when requested, and track follow\-up items.
* Support administrative activities associated with Procurement systems, P2P implementation, user resources, and department projects.
* Assist with maintaining and distributing coordinator\-level process guides, training materials, and procedural resources.
* Facilitate virtual meetings and training sessions using Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or similar platforms.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**


* High School Diploma/GED \- or equivalent
* 4 years of progressively responsible experience in general office clerical or secretarial work.
* Experience in working independently, ability to set priorities and be accountable for work results
* Ability to apply judgment, discretion, and initiative to difficult problems with creative solutions.
* Experience presenting information and responding to questions from faculty, staff, administration, customers and the general public.
* Thorough mastery of English grammar, punctuation, and spelling
* Thorough knowledge of office software packages, technology, and systems
* Working knowledge of budget policies and procedures
* Ability to independently handle multiple work unit priorities and projects
* Ability to analyze operational and procedural problems and develop, recommend, and evaluate proposed solutions.
* Ability to perform business math, such as calculate ratios and percentages, track financial data, and make simple projections.
* Ability to draft and compose correspondence and standard reports
* Ability to effectively handle a broader range of interpersonal interactions, including those at a higher level and those sensitive in nature.
* Familiarity with an integrated financial system
* Ability to utilize databases for storing, retrieving, and tracking documentation and projects
* Ability to read and understand the campus, CSU, and state policies
*

jobs.title: Institutional Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

This is an Institutional Account Manager position in a startup Pharma organization being built to launch a cardiovascular product in the critical care space. Reporting to the Syneos Health Area Business Director, the Account Manager will be responsible for engaging key stakeholders within complex hospital accounts, institutional systems and integrated delivery networks (IDNs).

**Responsibilities:**

* Maximize relationships with key academic institutions, IDNs and GPOs and leverage these relationships to generate increased demand and access for the product by targeting appropriate prescribers and decision influencers within the hospital.
* Partner with health systems to influence heads of departments, service line leaders, RNs, floor directors, and hospital pharmacy to secure formulary access and pull through of product utilization in the Hospital.
* Increase adoption and pull through of institutional/GPO contracts.
* Partner with administrators within health systems to remove barriers to appropriate use of product.
* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.). Build relationships in institutions aligned with customer segmentation.
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Collaboratively build account plans with field colleagues and leadership, that will increase demand and patient care.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in required training and development programs.
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures.

**Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required.
* 5\+ years pharmaceutical/biotech sales experience.
* 2\+ years cardiovascular sales experience in the Hospital setting is required.
* Hospital/Institutional experience highly preferred.
* Knowledge of formulary approval process and driving formulary approvals is preferred.
* Must live within territory or within territory boundaries.
* Proven track record of success in a high science competitive selling environment.
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication.
* Self\-starter, highly motivated to succeed.
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills.
* Ability to work independently or in a team environment.


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $155,000 to $170,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

  

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

  

40000

jobs.title: Commercial Insurance Account Manager - Transportation / Trucking
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Title: Account Manager \- Commercial Lines**

**Remote:** Arizona**,** California, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, Utah and Washington residents

**Supporting:** IOA \- Salt Lake City \| **Book Focus:** Commercial Transportation \& Trucking

**Requirement:** active P\&C license and commercial transportation/trucking experience  

  

*Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50\-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on\-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction\-free workspace.* *Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours.* *To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations*  

  

**About the Role****:** Manage an assigned book of business, ensuring account retention and supporting new business. Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative and customer service activities, resolving complex issues, and ensuring no errors or omissions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Competence**: Maintain technical competence and industry expertise.
* **Team Leadership**: Direct daily activities of the account management team.
* **Customer Service**: Handle customer service requests, policy administration, billing, claims, and coverage analysis.
* **Policy Management**: Manage policy expirations and renewals.
* **Renewal Process**: Conduct client research, prepare submissions, negotiate coverages, and present proposals.
* **Accounts Receivable**: Monitor reports and take action on delinquent accounts, collecting outstanding balances.
* **System Maintenance**: Maintain agency management systems and carrier/vendor platforms, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* **Activity Monitoring:** Monitor and maintain activity/suspense to ensure timely completion.
* **Communication:** Maintain frequent, transparent communication with the account team regarding workload status and any issues.
* **Service Excellence:** Deliver excellent service, proactively anticipate needs, and respond quickly to service requests.
* **Policy Compliance:** Stay updated on company policies and procedures.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Seek and adopt best practices to improve individual and team performance.
* **Champion IOA Values:** Demonstrate integrity and leadership.
  

  

**Ideal Candidate** **Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years of account management experience, or 5\+ years in the insurance industry
* Thorough knowledge of insurance brokerage and client needs
* Required active licensing; professional designation (CIC or equivalent) preferred
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Exceptional customer service, communication, multitasking, and organizational skills
* Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
* High School Diploma (or equivalent)
  

  

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salaries and bonus potential
* Company\-paid health insurance
* Paid holidays, vacations, and sick time
* 401K with employer match
* Professional growth and career progression opportunities
* Respectful culture and work/family life balance
* Community service commitment
* Supportive teammates and a rewarding work environment
  

  

**What to Expect** **(Application Process)****:**

* 30\-Minute Phone Screen, Online Assessments, and Interview(s)
**Salary Range**


The expected pay range for this position is $88,000\.00 to $95,000\.00 per year, depending on experience, relevant skills, and geographic location


Insurance Office of America is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Outside Parts Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Description:

Air Treatment Corporation fosters a dynamic, collaborative work environment built on teamwork, exceptional customer service, and a commitment to excellence. We value our employees and are dedicated to supporting their professional growth by providing opportunities for development and advancement from within. Our comprehensive benefits package and supportive culture reflect our commitment to the success and well\-being of our team members.

**Job Summary:**


This is a field\-based sales position responsible for developing new business, expanding existing accounts, and building long\-term relationships with mechanical contractors, HVAC service companies, facility owners, maintenance departments, technicians, and purchasing professionals.


The Outside Parts Sales Representative will identify replacement and repair opportunities, conduct customer and jobsite visits, identify equipment and parts requirements, prepare quotations, and close sales. This position will work closely with our inside parts sales/counter team, warehouse, purchasing, and manufacturer partners to ensure customers receive the **right part, at the right price, and when they need it.**

**Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Develop and grow parts sales within an assigned territory (SoCal SD, LA, OC) by regularly calling on mechanical contractors, service/repair companies, facility maintenance departments, and other commercial HVAC end users.
* The Outside Parts Sales Representative is accountable for achieving established sales and gross profit objectives through territory development, new business generation, account growth, and consistent follow\-up on sales opportunities
* Identify replacement parts opportunities through jobsite visits, equipment surveys, and relationship\-building with technicians and purchasing contacts.
* Prepare and present accurate price quotes; follow up to close sales and meet or exceed monthly/annual sales targets.
* Maintain and expand relationships with existing accounts while actively prospecting new customers.
* Partner with the inside parts sales/counter team to source parts, check stock and lead times, and process orders accurately.
* Cross\-reference OEM part numbers and identify correct replacement parts across represented manufacturer lines.
* Communicate customer needs, competitive activity, and market trends back to the Parts Manager and manufacturer partners.
* Resolve customer issues (returns, warranty claims, order discrepancies) promptly and professionally.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activity, customer visits, and pipeline in CRM/ERP systems.
* Attend manufacturer training sessions and industry events to stay current on product lines and technology.
* Represent the company professionally in the field, including at trade shows, contractor events, and lunch\-and\-learns.


Requirements:
**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals.
* Strong relationship\-building, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Comfortable reading equipment nameplates, parts manuals, and cross\-reference guides.
* Proficient with CRM software, Microsoft Office, and standard order\-entry/ERP systems.
* Self\-motivated and able to manage a territory with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to plan daily customer calls and manage an active sales pipeline.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with inside sales, warehouse, purchasing, and manufacturer partners.
* Ability to understand customer needs and recommend practical, cost\-effective parts and product solutions.

**Education and Experience:**

* 2\+ years of outside sales experience; commercial HVAC, mechanical, or industrial parts/equipment experience strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of commercial HVAC equipment and components (compressors, motors, controls, coils, valves, etc.) or strong aptitude to learn quickly.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate's/bachelor's degree or technical certification a plus.
* Experience selling HVAC replacement parts, equipment, or related mechanical products in a B2B environment is highly preferred.
* Established relationships with commercial HVAC contractors, service companies, or facility maintenance professionals is a plus.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to sit for prolonged periods, with the ability to periodically stand, walk, and change positions as needed.
* Must be able to use a computer, keyboard, mouse, telephone, and other standard office equipment on a regular basis.
* Must have the ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, and through electronic communication.
* Regular local travel throughout the assigned territory, including customer sites, jobsites, and mechanical rooms.
* Ability to lift and carry parts/samples up to approximately 40 lbs.
* Exposure to mechanical rooms, rooftops, and job sites in varying conditions; use of appropriate PPE as required.
* Extensive time spent driving; reliable personal or company vehicle required.
* Ability to safely navigate construction jobsites, warehouses, mechanical rooms, rooftops, and other commercial/industrial environments.
* Ability to climb stairs, ladders, and access equipment areas when required during customer visits or equipment surveys.
* Ability to work outdoors and in varying weather conditions as required by customer and jobsite visits.

Do you enjoy connecting people to reliable telecommunication services while engaging directly with your community? As an Outside Sales Representative at Spectrum, you will represent our trusted products through face\-to\-face interactions with prospective customers, expanding access to high\-speed data and communication solutions. Your efforts will drive meaningful connections and contribute to Spectrum’s growth and customer satisfaction.  

Join Spectrum and unlock your potential with a competitive base salary plus lucrative incentives that can bring top performers to a total compensation of over $100,000 a year! And that’s not all, enjoy free and discounted Spectrum services like internet, TV, and mobile while building a long and rewarding career. **How You’ll Make an Impact*** Acquire new residential customers by visiting assigned leads and introducing Spectrum’s offerings
* Conduct consultative needs analyses to tailor product recommendations for each prospective customer
* Present compelling sales proposals that align with customer needs and highlight Spectrum’s solutions
* Complete all required sales documentation accurately, including dispositioning, order entry and reporting
* Participate actively in sales meetings and training sessions to support team goals and professional development
* Achieve monthly sales targets across high\-speed data, mobile, landline phone and video services
* Monitor competitors’ activities within your territory and communicate relevant information to your manager

**Working Conditions*** Spend approximately 90% of time outdoors in all seasons, with potential exposure to inclement weather

* Exposure to moderate noise levels

* Engaging interpersonal skills
* Ability to listen, formulate needs based sales strategies, and articulate pitches to sell products and services
* A passion to succeed and strong personal drive to sell to prospective customers

* Familiarity with computer operating systems and software applications as well as consumer and commercial communication devices (e.g., PDAs, smartphones, routers, modems, set\-top converters, and wireless devices)
* Must be able to work evenings and weekends, and as business needs dictate to maximize prospective customer contact
* Ability to work independently with little or no supervision
* A valid driver’s license, car insurance, a satisfactory driving record, and the use of a reliable personal vehicle

**Preferred Qualifications** **Experience*** 2\+ years sales or relevant work experience

**Skills*** Success in a previous sales position, prospecting or cold calling; direct sales experience is preferred
* Knowledge of cable or telecommunications services, with an emphasis on data networking fundamentals and ability to educate consumers on related products and services as needed

* Able to lift and transport 10\-20 pounds

jobs.title: Social Media Manager - LA [Bilingual in Korean]
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Social Media Manager**

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  

**Compensation:** $30–$40 per hour, DOE  

**Experience:** 3–5\+ years preferred


About the Brands


We are a growing fashion and lifestyle company seeking a creative, fashion\-driven, and results\-oriented **Social Media Manager** to lead the social media presence and growth of our brands:


About the Role


We are looking for a hands\-on Social Media Manager who understands fashion, social media culture, content creation, brand storytelling, and performance\-driven growth.


This is not a role focused solely on scheduling posts. The ideal candidate will take ownership of each brand's social media presence—from strategy and content planning to execution, community engagement, influencer coordination, paid social support, analytics, and growth.


You will work closely with our Design and E\-Commerce teams while taking primary ownership of social media strategy and day\-to\-day execution across multiple fashion and lifestyle brands.

 **Job Description** **Social Media Strategy \& Brand Management**

* Develop and execute distinct social media strategies for multiple fashion and lifestyle brands.
* Establish and maintain a clear, consistent social identity, voice, and visual direction for each brand.
* Create and manage monthly and weekly social media content calendars.
* Identify relevant fashion, lifestyle, cultural, and social media trends and translate them into brand\-appropriate content.

**Content Creation \& Execution**

* Plan and manage content across Instagram, Reels, Stories, TikTok, Facebook, and other relevant platforms.
* Create engaging short\-form content using available product, model, lifestyle, and behind\-the\-scenes assets.
* Coordinate with Design and E\-Commerce teams regarding new products, collections, seasonal campaigns, and key product launches.
* Write compelling, brand\-appropriate captions and social media copy.
* Coordinate product shoots and social content shoots as needed.
* Maintain a consistent and effective posting schedule across all brands.

**Community \& Influencer Management**

* Monitor and respond to comments, direct messages, tags, mentions, and other customer engagement.
* Build relationships with followers and strengthen each brand's online community.
* Identify and coordinate with influencers, creators, and micro\-influencers.
* Support product seeding, creator collaborations, and influencer marketing initiatives.
* Track creator and influencer performance.

**Growth \& Paid Social**

* Develop strategies to increase qualified followers, engagement, website traffic, and conversions.
* Collaborate with the E\-Commerce team on Instagram and Facebook advertising, boosted posts, and social media campaigns.
* Test creative concepts, audiences, formats, and messaging to improve campaign performance.
* Identify high\-performing organic content that may be expanded through paid promotion.

**Analytics \& Reporting**

* Track and analyze weekly and monthly social media KPIs, including:


	+ Follower growth
	+ Reach and impressions
	+ Engagement rate
	+ Reels and video views
	+ Website traffic
	+ Conversion and sales, when measurable
	+ Top\-performing products and content
* Prepare concise weekly social media performance reports.
* Provide actionable recommendations based on performance data and trends.

 **Qualifications** **Must bilingual in Korean**

* 3–5\+ years of hands\-on social media management experience, preferably within fashion, apparel, beauty, lifestyle, or consumer brands.
* Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook/Meta, and emerging social media platforms.
* Strong understanding of fashion trends, lifestyle content, social media culture, and young consumer behavior.
* Demonstrated experience growing social media audiences and increasing engagement.
* Experience creating short\-form video content, particularly Instagram Reels and TikTok.
* Strong visual judgment and understanding of fashion merchandising and brand storytelling.
* Excellent written communication and caption\-writing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple brands and projects while maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of social media strategy and execution.


Preferred

* Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar content creation tools.
* Understanding of Meta Business Suite and Meta Ads Manager.
* Shopify or e\-commerce experience.
* Experience with influencer, creator, or affiliate marketing

 **Additional Information**  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
**HomeShield Pest Control**
===========================

**Sales Operations Manager — Job Description \& Compensation Plan**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA**Position Type:** Full\-Time**Reports To:** Sales Manager

### **About HomeShield Pest Control**


At HomeShield Pest Control, we provide top\-tier pest management solutions driven by customer satisfaction, team growth, and operational excellence. As we expand our reach, we are seeking a dedicated and strategic **Sales Operations Manager** to lead, mentor, and optimize our field sales team.

### **Position Summary**


The **Sales Operations Manager** plays a critical leadership role in driving field sales performance, improving close rates, and ensuring higher contract values across the sales team. You will work closely with sales representatives through direct field coaching, ride\-alongs, performance reporting, and process optimization to ensure operational consistency, inspection accuracy, and sales excellence.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Field Coaching \& Development:** Conduct regular field ride\-alongs with sales representatives to observe, evaluate, and coach them on inspection techniques, customer communication, and closing strategies.
* **Performance Management:** Track individual and team sales metrics, providing actionable feedback and structured follow\-up plans following field evaluations.
* **Sales Strategy \& Execution:** Implement sales operational strategies to drive team conversion rates and increase average contract values.
* **Reporting \& Analysis:** Generate comprehensive post\-ride\-along reports, track team KPIs, and report performance trends directly to senior executive leadership.
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Serve as a bridge between field sales representatives and operational leadership to streamline lead flow, scheduling, and service delivery.
* **Training \& Onboarding:** Help train new sales hires on HomeShield's sales scripts, inspection standards, CRM tools, and compliance protocols.

### **Qualifications \& Requirements**

* Proven track record in sales management, sales operations, or field sales leadership (pest control or home services industry experience strongly preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and elevate sales team performance.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn key metrics into actionable field strategies.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Valid Driver's License with a clean driving record and willingness to conduct field work across Los Angeles county.

This includes adopting a collaborative approach to create consistent, favorable circumstances that foster success and effectiveness for the Organization and the communities.
* **An Authentic Attitude \-** Consistently demonstrate an open and professional attitude and approach when accessing and resolving resident and staff concerns. This includes, but is not limited to, seeking resources throughout the organization via the organization's support services and senior leadership.
* **An Approach that is positive and Professional** \- Consistently demonstrate an approach of active listening and understand that your participation and support are integral to the success of Avanath, ensuring that each resident and staff member feels seen, heard, and valued as you and the staff work to resolve challenges.


**Qualifications**


* 2\+ years' experience as an Assistant Community Manager.
* LIHTC/Tax Credit Program Knowledge required.
* Equipped with excellent communication skills and an unmatched dedication to customer service.
* Solid track record of bookkeeping and rent collection.
* Thorough understanding of landlord/tenant law.
* Strong Understanding of Fair Housing Laws.
* Superior interpersonal skills: ability to get along with diverse personalities; tactful; mature, flexible.
* Resourceful and organized.
* Solid computer knowledge, Windows (Word, Excel), internet, and e\-mail.
* Working knowledge of Yardi Voyager Property Management software.


**Key Accountabilities**

\+ **Resident Relations \+ Customer Service**


* At all times, regardless, provides A\+ customer service.
* Manages and promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Functions as a resource center for residents on all things that affect and may disturb their community\-living experience and ability to make timely rent payments.
* Organizes and executes resident appreciation and retention events.
* Maintains a secure, confidential file for each resident.
* Answering phones, greeting walk\-ins, and handling foot traffic.
* Assist with leasing job duties, including touring prospective residents.


\+ **Fiduciary**


* Handles all the monies of the property. Collects, posts, and deposits rents/security deposits and other community income.
* Reviews resident files and ledger records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease agreements.
* Assist with Monthly Projection Reporting, inspect vacancies, make\-ready apartments, and models. Inspects the property for community policy violations, needed repairs, and overall landscaping.
* Meets regularly with Community Manager and Regional Manager to discuss community performance.
* Other duties as assigned by Community Manager.


\+ **Staff Leadership**


* Maintains a service\-oriented environment by always exhibiting a professional appearance and attitude.
* Oversees property operations and staff in Community Manager's absence.
* Support Leasing Consultants in the leasing of apartments and ensure that Fair Housing guidelines are followed.
* Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.


\+ **Adherence to Property Management Rules, Regulations, and Guidelines**


* Conduct all business in accordance with company policies and procedures, Fair Housing, *Americans with Disabilities Act,* and all other laws pertaining to the apartment industry.
* Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.
* Follows the Company's established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the property as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.


**Physical Demands \& Working Conditions**

* The incumbent in this position is classified as essential staff and is expected to report to work and adhere to all safety and business protocols.
* Frequent sitting and walking.
* Repetitive use of the computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone.
* Reading, comprehending, writing, performing calculations, and communicating verbally.
* May work in an elevated site, may walk on uneven ground.
* Occasional squatting, bending neck/waist, twisting neck/waist, pushing, and pulling.

REPORTS TO: STORE SUPPORT MERCHANDISE MANAGER

**Summary**

Our vision is to offer everyone a piece of the American spirit – one handshake at a time.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - SPG
jobs.description:
Summary
  
For our Orange County office Ca Balfour Beatty Construction is seeking an Assistant Project Manager. This role is responsible for assisting the Project Manager in managing all administrative and technical requirements for construction special projects. Assists in all activities related to contract administration, change orders, submittals, procurement, project financials, set\-up and updates, and schedule to ensure projects are completed in a quality, profitable, safe, sustainable, and timely manner. Maintain constant focus on meeting/exceeding customer needs and expectations by supporting the Project Manager in all aspects of assigned projects.
  
Essential Functions
  
* Project Financial Analysis
* Preconstruction Coordination
* Project Scheduling
* Project Administration, Operations, and Close\-out
* Promote Customer and Community Relations
* Foster Positive Culture, Leadership and Employee Development


Minimum Requirements
  
* Bachelor's Degree required.
* At least 5 years of previous construction office or field commercial experience in a Project Engineer, Senior Project Engineer, or Assistant Project Manager role.
* 1\-year or more of direct supervisory experience.
* Experience with project manager software (Constructware, P6, Timberline, etc.).
* Experience with cost projection, financial analysis, budget reviews, labor reports.
* Experience with JD Edwards or similar construction application(s).


Preferred Experience
  
* Local candidates preferred but not required.
* DSA/ Public works experience is a plus
* Commissioning Coordinator experience
* Experience in Change Orders Drafting/Negotiating
* Knows how to drive material procurement as it relates to schedule
* Can read a look ahead and CPM schedule
* Capable of facilitating meetings
* Experience in reviewing sub\-billings


The base compensation range for the role of Assistant Project Manager in Southern CA, posted above is $105,000 to $125,000 annually.
  
This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, incentive, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company's sole discretion, consistent with the law and any applicable plan documents.
  
Balfour Beatty is an equal opportunity employer that recognizes the value of a diverse workforce. All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other criteria protected by federal, state or local law.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Title: Account Manager \- Commercial Lines**

**Remote:** Arizona**,** California, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, Utah and Washington residents

**Supporting:** IOA \- Salt Lake City \| **Book Focus:** Commercial Transportation \& Trucking

**Requirement:** active P\&C license and commercial transportation/trucking experience  

  

*Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50\-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on\-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction\-free workspace.* *Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours.* *To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations*  

  

**About the Role****:** Manage an assigned book of business, ensuring account retention and supporting new business. Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative and customer service activities, resolving complex issues, and ensuring no errors or omissions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Competence**: Maintain technical competence and industry expertise.
* **Team Leadership**: Direct daily activities of the account management team.
* **Customer Service**: Handle customer service requests, policy administration, billing, claims, and coverage analysis.
* **Policy Management**: Manage policy expirations and renewals.
* **Renewal Process**: Conduct client research, prepare submissions, negotiate coverages, and present proposals.
* **Accounts Receivable**: Monitor reports and take action on delinquent accounts, collecting outstanding balances.
* **System Maintenance**: Maintain agency management systems and carrier/vendor platforms, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* **Activity Monitoring:** Monitor and maintain activity/suspense to ensure timely completion.
* **Communication:** Maintain frequent, transparent communication with the account team regarding workload status and any issues.
* **Service Excellence:** Deliver excellent service, proactively anticipate needs, and respond quickly to service requests.
* **Policy Compliance:** Stay updated on company policies and procedures.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Seek and adopt best practices to improve individual and team performance.
* **Champion IOA Values:** Demonstrate integrity and leadership.
  

  

**Ideal Candidate** **Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years of account management experience, or 5\+ years in the insurance industry
* Thorough knowledge of insurance brokerage and client needs
* Required active licensing; professional designation (CIC or equivalent) preferred
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Exceptional customer service, communication, multitasking, and organizational skills
* Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
* High School Diploma (or equivalent)
  

  

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salaries and bonus potential
* Company\-paid health insurance
* Paid holidays, vacations, and sick time
* 401K with employer match
* Professional growth and career progression opportunities
* Respectful culture and work/family life balance
* Community service commitment
* Supportive teammates and a rewarding work environment
  

  

**What to Expect** **(Application Process)****:**

* 30\-Minute Phone Screen, Online Assessments, and Interview(s)
**Salary Range**


The expected pay range for this position is $88,000\.00 to $95,000\.00 per year, depending on experience, relevant skills, and geographic location


Insurance Office of America is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
At El Pollo Loco, we are on a mission to be the nation’s leading fire\-grilled chicken restaurant. When it comes to our people, we are all about growth. Whether that means specialized training, a clearly laid out career trajectory or collaborating cross\-functionally, we are committed to the success of our people the same way we’ve been committed to the success of the El Pollo Loco brand for the last 50 years. In fact, we see you as our secret ingredient. While our chicken is fire, it’s our people who set us ablaze.
  
  

Our restaurants are only the tip of the flame! If you’re looking for an innovative, winning, and welcoming workplace, then a flamin’ good career in our Restaurant Support Center is right for you.
  
  

At our Support Center, we believe our best work is done Together, when departments collaborate and everyone is confident in contributing their ideas. This is why we are in the office 3 days per week.
  
  

Let’s Get Loco!
  
  

What’s in it for you!
  
* STRONG office culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® and driven by our core values: Simple. Together. Relentless. Ownership. Nimble. Growth
* Career growth opportunities
* Competitive pay and bonus potential
* Medical \+ Dental \+ Vision Insurance \+ HSA Savings Account
* 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match and immediate vesting
* Paid Vacation \+ Sick Pay \+ 12 Paid Holidays
* Employee Assistance Program
* Free El Pollo Loco food \+ restaurant discounts
* PerkSpot discounts program


**POSITION PURPOSE:**  

The Executive Assistant provides high\-level administrative, operational, and logistical support to one or more company executives and their corresponding leadership teams. This role serves as a trusted partner, ensuring seamless day\-to\-day operations, effective communication, coordination with senior staff members as well as board members, and professional representation of the company to internal and external stakeholders.
  
  

Due to the nature of the work—including in\-person executive support, coordination of company visitors, handling confidential materials, and execution of special projects—this position requires a minimum of four (4\) days per week working on\-site. Regular in\-office presence is an essential function of the role. Remote work is complementary and does not replace the required in\-office presence necessary to fulfill the essential functions of this role.
  
  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Provide real\-time, administrative support to executive(s), including calendar management, meeting coordination, note taking, recording of action items, expense reporting, composing and preparing correspondence, arranging complex and detailed travel, and urgent day\-of schedule changes.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for executive(s), responding to immediate needs and facilitating decision\-making.
* Prepare, assemble, print, and distribute physical meeting materials, presentations, and briefing packets as needed.
* Maintain executive offices, ensuring readiness for meetings, visits, and confidential discussions.
* Greet and support company visitors, board members, candidates, vendors, and partners in a professional and welcoming manner.
* Coordinate in\-person meetings, leadership offsites, board meetings, itineraries and agendas and special events including room setup, catering, technology readiness, and materials.
* Provide on\-site support during meetings and events to address real\-time issues and ensure smooth execution.
* Support special projects that require in\-person collaboration, coordination, and follow\-through with executive leadership and partner teams.
* Provide a bridge for smooth communication between the executive’s office and internal departments, demonstrating leadership to maintain credibility, trust and support with senior management.
* Coordinate closely with other Executive Assistants and functional teams as needed on in\-office matters impacting executive leadership, including handling temporary work overloads and providing administrative coverage or back\-up support for other executives or departments when needed.
* Plans and leads 10\-15 large operations and marketing Meetings throughout the year, including Field Operations All\-Hands, Franchisee Meetings, and DMA Meetings.
* Owns the building and ongoing management of the El Pollo Loco Brand Calendar
* Manages field hierarchy alignment documents and communication with the organization
* Provides reporting, budgeting, and invoice support to operations and marketing executives
* Is the lead planner and coordination for the brand’s Annual Conference. Manage vendors, organizes the EPL Foundation Raffle, orders swag and custom gifts, and provides any other necessary assistance for this multi\-day event.
* Handle highly confidential and sensitive information requiring secure, controlled, and professional in\-office management.
* Support executive discussions and documentation that necessitate discretion and limited access.
* Support administrative and operational needs tied to physical office presence, including mail handling, document management, office coordination, and executive workspace readiness; share in responsibility of managing front desk/reception area.
* Ensure continuity of executive support during in\-office business hours.
* Other activities, duties or responsibilities that are assigned by your supervisor.
