**POSITION PURPOSE:**  

El Pollo Loco is looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our marketing organization. This role owns traffic and workflow management across the marketing team, integrated agency team (IAT) and campaign activations — ensuring work moves smoothly from brief to execution to launch. You’ll will be instrumental in helping to create and manage our brand ambassador program, acting as the connective tissue between strategy and on\-the\-ground execution.
  
This is a great fit for someone who thrives on process, loves keeping cross\-functional teams aligned, and wants visibility across every marketing initiative from concept through launch.
  
  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Own end\-to\-end traffic and workflow management across the marketing organization, coordinating intake, prioritization, and timelines across the creative and content team and the broader marketing team.
* Partner with project managers and activation leads to keep campaigns, content, and creative on schedule and within scope.
* Build and maintain marketing operations systems — project tracking, resourcing, briefs, approvals — that keep teams aligned and reduce bottlenecks.
* Manage the brand ambassador program, including recruiting, onboarding, activation logistics, and performance tracking.
* Serve as a central point of contact for status updates, timeline changes, and resourcing conflicts across marketing initiatives.
* Identify and implement process improvements to increase team efficiency and campaign velocity.


QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:
  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required.
  
  

**Education/Work Experience:**  

* 3\-5\+ years of experience in marketing operations, project/traffic management, or a similar coordination\-heavy marketing role, ideally at the manager level.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with project management/traffic tools (Asana, Monday, Wrike, or similar).
* Strong communication and organizational skills; comfortable being the person who keeps everyone on track.
* A go\-getter mindset \- Proactively anticipates project needs, risks, and potential roadblocks—thinking several steps ahead to identify issues early and develop and present solutions before they impact the work.
* Experience managing ambassador, influencer, or field marketing programs is a plus.
* Retail, restaurant, or CPG marketing experience is a plus.


Our Company
  
  

In 1980 the first American El Pollo Loco opened on Alvarado Street in Los Angeles, quickly becoming a destination for the best citrus\-marinated, fire\-grilled pollo in town. Over the past four decades, El Pollo Loco has grown into more than 500 restaurants across 9 states, becoming an L.A. mainstay and cultural benchmark along the way. Today, we continue to work just as hard to always provide our customers with Quality Chicken. Fast. Easy. Affordable.
  
  

The pay range identified is the hourly or salary rate El Pollo Loco expects to pay for the posted position. This range does not include any benefits or bonus opportunities that might be available for the position based on position and eligibility criteria. At El Pollo Loco, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range. Individual pay decisions will vary based on a variety of factors including years of experience, industry experience, education, geography, etc.

jobs.title: Scaled Customer Success Manager - Ads
jobs.description:
**About Us:**



Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100\+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry\-leading AI and real\-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10's SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry's most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes.



At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don't just happen — they're built. Here, you'll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that's redefining the future of commerce.


**About the Role:**


* As a Scaled Customer Success Manager focused on Ads, you will build and manage our digital and 1:Many Customer Success strategies specifically for customers leveraging Helium 10 Ads and Amazon Seller Central advertising solutions. In this role, you will manage a broad portfolio of customers, ensuring their success by providing exceptional support and guidance through a one\-to\-many approach via developed playbooks, content delivery, metrics, and the right level of automation. You will also carry and grow a small book of direct customer relationships, blending scaled digital engagement with strategic 1:1 partnership.
* To excel in this role, you will need complete command of the scaled customer success discipline, including program design, ads strategy, and cross\-portfolio retention economics, with the judgment to set direction without relying on established playbooks. You will be at the forefront of designing innovative programs grounded in data insights about ad performance, campaign management, and ROI optimization. You'll be ready to adapt and iterate for continuous improvement while helping sellers maximize their advertising investment on Amazon.


**Responsibilities:**


* Diagnose and solve diverse, undefined retention and expansion challenges across the ads portfolio, building new frameworks and precedent where none exist — including onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion strategy — rather than executing against a defined playbook.
* Become an expert on Helium 10 Ads and Amazon Seller Central advertising tools, including campaign management features, bid optimization, keyword targeting, and performance metrics. Utilize this knowledge to build scaled engagement strategies that drive advertising ROI and customer success.
* Manage a small book of direct business by maintaining strategic relationships with key accounts, conducting quarterly business reviews, identifying expansion opportunities within the ads product suite, and ensuring personalized support for high\-value advertising customers.
* Familiarize yourself with the full suite of Helium 10 products with emphasis on ad\-related tools and how they integrate with broader seller strategies. Help develop strategies that position advertising as a core growth lever for customer success.
* Become an expert on new Helium 10 ads products and enhancements, assisting in scaling awareness and adoption of new advertising features, campaign types, and optimization capabilities across your customer base.
* Utilize customer data to identify trends in ad performance, spend patterns, and campaign outcomes. Create targeted engagement campaigns for customers at different spots in their advertising journey, from campaign setup to advanced optimization and scaling.
* Exercise independent judgment on retention and expansion strategy across the full ads book, with decisions reviewed only at major milestones rather than in regular check\-ins, given the direct impact on portfolio\-wide revenue outcomes.
* Evaluate the self\-serve experience for ads products and work to continually improve and evolve based on customer feedback and usage data. Partner with product teams to enhance the user experience for advertising features.
* Serve as the primary point of judgment for Support, Marketing, Product, and Brand Evangelists on ads\-related customer strategy, shaping how those teams prioritize and execute educational resources and cross\-functional initiatives..
* Iterate and test scaled program initiatives with emphasis on ads engagement, onboarding, and adoption campaigns. Track and report on results, customer feedback, and ROI improvements from your initiatives.


**Skills \& Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Community Program Coordinator (Richmond & Pullman)
jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self\-reliance and personal growth.  

  

Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project\-access.org/success\-stories/

 **The opportunity**


The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long\-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

**What you'll do**

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth \& Families, Health \& Wellness, and Community Building.
* Coordinate and oversee an after\-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
* Develop \& maintain partnerships with local providers.
* Plan \& facilitate community\-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
* Provide residents with information \& referrals to access community resources and services.
* Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events
* Collect \& submit program outcomes data

**What you'll bring**

* Four years of experience in multi\-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
* Experience in:
* + after\-school programs or educational settings for youth
	+ serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness
* Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
* Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
* Self\-starter, multi\-tasker, and strong communicator
* The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.

**Credentials/Certifications**
==============================

* Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance
* CPR \& First Aid certified (or obtained within 90 days of hire)
* Successful completion of background check

**The details:**

* **This is a full\-time (32 hrs/wk), non\-exempt position and provides services at two sites.**
* **Schedule:** **Monday through Thursday, 9am\-5:30pm.** Ability to work occasional Saturday for an event. Schedule subject to change.
* **Location**:
* + Richmond Village: 700 S 26th St, Richmond, CA 94804
	+ Pullman Point: 2801 Pullman Ave, Richmond, CA 94804
* **Wage:** $28/hr
* **Benefits offered**:
* + Health insurance, dental insurance, term life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Additionally, the following voluntary benefits are available at 100% employee cost: vision insurance, voluntary life insurance, pet insurance, and supplemental benefits.
	+ Safe Harbor 401(k) with 4% company match
	+ Paid time off \+ 14 paid holidays

We value diversity in all its forms and actively seek to build a team that reflects the richness of our community. jobs.title: Privacy Program Specialist, Consultant
jobs.description:
**Your Role**

The Privacy Office is responsible for development, implementation, and oversight of Blue Shield’s Privacy Program. The Privacy Program ensures that Blue Shield and its affiliated covered entities, including Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan, are in compliance with state and federal privacy laws and regulations, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA), the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health Act of 2009 (HITECH), and California’s Confidentiality of Medical Information Act (CMIA). The Privacy Program Specialist, Consultant reports to the Privacy Office Sr. Manager and plays an essential role in advancing and enforcing Blue Shield’s Privacy Program.


  
**Your Work**

In this role, you will:  



* Be responsible for the oversight of Blue Shield's compliance with state and federal privacy laws, including the privacy component of HIPAA and HITECH
* The majority of this role involves leading assigned privacy investigations, timely and accurately document case files, direct investigations into root cause analysis, address mitigation, and work with impacted business units to develop and complete corrective action for remediation and to minimize risk of recurrence
* Consult with internal clients to review and provide privacy guidance about proposed projects and initiatives and serve as a privacy subject matter expert
* Respond to privacy\-related requests and inquiries
* Develop and assist with the implementation of workforce privacy training programs, privacy policies, desk\-level procedures, resource guides, job aids, and other educational tools
* Act as a liaison with regulatory enforcement agencies to address technical assistance letters, investigation compliance reviews, audits, and other related reviews

jobs.description:
The Fixed\-Term Administrative Coordinator for the Marketing division works closely with the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) and Directors of the Marketing Division to support the overall coordination of strategic division initiatives and overall administrative support for the Division.  

In addition to providing administrative support to the CMO and Directors of the Marketing division, the Administrative Coordinator serves as coordinator for division projects and will take on specific duties assigned by the CMO.


This is a 6\-month fixed\-term position, from approximately mid\-October 2026 \- mid\-April 2027\. The application deadline is Sunday, September 13, 2026, 9 PM PST. **Duties and Responsibilities:**


1\. Provides administrative support to the entire Marketing division by scheduling meetings, preparing presentations, aggregating research, responding to accounting and human resource administrative needs, tracking strategic projects, contract trafficking and other division workflows. Drafts internal and external correspondence. Proactively anticipates future needs based on the upcoming events, meetings, deadlines, and other activities.


2\. Under direction of the Chief Marketing Officer, serves as the key coordinator for the Brand Identity project: scheduling meetings and tracking deliverables for internal teams and with the external agency partner. Prepares materials to support project milestones. Writes briefs and summarizes feedback at key project milestones. Prepares summary decks. Communicates directly with the agency and internal teams to facilitate collaboration and project advancement. Coordinates calendaring and sharing of information for stakeholder input sessions and cross\-functional progress share outs. Tracks project SOW and timeline to ensure project’s overall success.


3\. Processes invoices and departmental expense reports; create purchase orders; assists with budget tracking Maintains and updates project flow in Asana, adds new tasks related to key projects, tracks overall progress and communicates with the team to ensure project milestones are met.


4\. Manages division Asana project integration into the workflow and planning process.


5\. Serves as project coordinator for division\-wide brand projects and marketing related inputs for Trustees and Board meetings. Prepares agendas and distributes meeting materials May attend meetings and take meetings and assign follow up action items for key projects.


6\. Delivers status reports for key projects and strategic initiatives across the division and, as relevant, to cross functional teams. Compiles insights into presentable, actionable reports for key stakeholders.


7\. Facilitates project advancement across the division by shepherding key documents and approvals through the division workflow, especially as related to milestone reporting for strategic initiatives, the brand project, and review of contracts or content for curatorial and legal review. Facilitates aggregating data and insights for third party reporting.


8\. Coordinates the Marketing Board Committee preparation, aggregating inputs and presentation needs, day of facilitation and drafting of minutes.


9\. Helps facilitate Marketing Division\-specific onboarding and offboarding procedures for new or departing division employees.


10\. Assists in all Marketing \& Communications department events, including press previews, social influencer meet\-ups, audience cultivation, and partnership events. Provides cross functional event planning coordination.


11\. Assists in assembling post\-exhibition marketing campaign reports and campaign analytics. Coordinates with media agency and the broader marketing division to aggregate data and insights into institutional archives.


12\. Updates project schedules in Asana to help teams meet deadlines; assists and coordinates production timelines to ensure timely distribution of materials.


13\. Performs light clerical duties (photocopying, filing, mailing).


14\. Performs other duties as assigned.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Liberal Arts or a closely related field from an accredited college or university.


Work Experience: Minimum of three years of office administration experience.


Skills and Abilities:

* Proficiency in Google Suite and Microsoft Office Suite, project management tools, and customer relationship management systems (CRMs).
* Proficiency in Asana as a project management tool
* Knowledge of marketing \+ communications best practices.
* Excellent organizational, writing, and communication skills.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective and appropriate working relationships.
* Ability to take direction, manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and take initiative.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, tact, and diplomacy.
* Flexibility in meeting shifting demands and priorities.
* Knowledge of art preferred.

Schedule: This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule. Hybrid schedules are a minimum of 4 days a week onsite, with the understanding that schedules may change based on operational needs. jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Works closely with and provides support to more experienced project managers on a variety of projects of varying complexity, and/or will manage some smaller and less complex projects on his or her own. For the projects an APM manages, he or she will act as the main coordinator and project liaison to the client, architect, general contractor, building manager, furniture and move vendors, and security, throughout each project. This person maintains document control, manages databases and coordinates and tracks project activities and communications to ensure project goals are accomplished within the prescribed timeframe and budget parameters.
  

  

**Essential Job Duties:**

* Obtain clear understanding of project scope from client, including high level details, prior to kick\-off meeting
* Guide client on realistic timeframe expected for each project
* Build and lead a successful team through all phases of each project
* Manage financials for each project, including obtaining approvals for initial and final budgets, release of purchase orders, tracking of existing and expected commitments, and timely approval of invoices
* Implement and document value engineering, with solutions to reduce spending or improve schedule, process, or final product, without an increase in cost
* Prepare status reports for management, client, project personnel and/or others and modify schedules or plans as required
* Maintain a filing system that documents all project activities
* Control project OAC meetings, site visits, punch\-list walkthroughs for construction or furniture, meeting vendors to provide access and oversight
* Upon project construction completion, coordinate project closeout by obtaining O\&M Manuals and building as\-builts, then issue them to planning / archive teams and to leasing team for landlord acceptance and release of TI allowances
* Document and share lessons learned
* It is understood that an APM will require guidance on some of the duties and responsibilities described above responsibilities described above
* Obtain and maintain client trust and loyalty
May perform other duties as assigned  
* 

**Skills, Education and Experience:**

* Minimum 3 years’ experience working in the commercial real estate industry
* Ability to embrace and adapt to the technology required to fulfill the responsibilities of this position (Word, Excel, Fasttrack)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Good organizational skills
* Ability to adapt to changing clients, workloads, and general requirements
Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four\-year college or university; or three to four years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience  
* 

**Benefits and Perks:**

* Industry leading Parental Leave Policy (up to 16 weeks)
* Generous healthcare
* Bright Horizons back\-up care program
* Generous paid time off
* Education reimbursement
* Referral Program
* Opportunities to network and connect

Benefits/perks listed may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Newmark and the job location.

The actual base salary will be determined on an individualized basis taking into account a wide range of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, education, and, where applicable, licenses or certifications held. In addition to base salary and a competitive benefits package, this position may be eligible for additional types of compensation including discretionary bonuses and other short\- and long\-term incentives (e.g., deferred cash, equity, etc.).

jobs.title: Certified Pilates Instructor (Operations Coordinator Position)
jobs.description:
Do you have a natural way with people and love to help people move and feel better using your skills as a Pilates Instructor?

If you’re an organized person who is looking for a place who appreciates and rewards good work…then you are someone who may be perfect for the position we have available!

We are a Physical Therapy and Pilates/Wellness practice looking for an energetic Certified Pilates Instructor who is a go\-getter and maybe wants to grow into a Pilates Director role to oversee and manage the Pilates/Wellness side of our practice. We take people who are "broken" and in pain and help them transform their lives by guiding them through their rehab and then back to fitness and wellness. You would initially start as a part\-time Pilates Instructor. As the position grows and evolves into Director position (if that's what you want, it's NOT required), you will have a flexible schedule working approximately 20 hours/week and split your time teaching classes, semi\-private sessions, privates sessions, and attending bi\-monthly staff training/meetings. Must be willing to teach occasional evenings to cover vacation as well as several morning classes. This position requires excellent communication and organizational skills as you will be discussing client needs with the Physical Therapists and managing/scheduling the clients.

Rehab experience is a plus but not necessary as we are willing to train the right person. Continuing education, quality instruction and customer service are important core values in our company. You must be comfortable with being videotaped doing exercises or teaching on social media as this is a common way that we educate the public about what we do.

**Qualifications**

* Certified Pilates Instructor with a strong background in group fitness and teaching.
* Knowledge of anatomy, physiology, and body mechanics to ensure safe and effective instruction
* Excellent organizational and communication skills to foster a positive class environment.
* Familiarity with personal training and health club operations is a plus.

This is a great opportunity for an instructor who wants growth potential and would like to learn and practice Pilates for Rehab as well as for fitness. It is also possible for this to become a full\-time position for the right candidate.

Pay: $45\.00 \- $65\.00 per hour

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Flexible schedule

jobs.title: Global Events Operations Coordinator (FTC, 6 months)
jobs.description:
**About OpenAI**


OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.


At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

**About the Role**
==================


This 6\-month Global Events Operations Coordinator role will support the systems, processes, and operational workflows that help the Global Events team scale high\-quality programs across regions, audiences, and internal partners. This role will work closely with the Events Operations Manager and broader Global Events team to keep event planning organized, consistent, and moving at pace.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, comfortable with cross\-functional coordination, and excited to improve how event work gets done through strong systems, clear documentation, and smart use of tools including Airtable, Google Workspace, Swoogo, Slack, ChatGPT, and Codex.

**In this role, you will:**
===========================

* Support and maintain operational systems for the Global Events team, including trackers, planning templates, project plans, vendor records, event calendars, and shared documentation.
* Help coordinate cross\-functional event workflows across teams including Marketing, Communications, Sales, Recruiting, Workplace, IT, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Design, Production, and Executive Business Partners.
* Maintain vendor, contractor, venue, and partner databases to support consistent planning and execution across global programs.
* Support purchase requests, invoice tracking, budget reconciliation, and spend reporting to help ensure event expenses are accurate, documented, and aligned with internal processes.
* Help standardize event planning processes, templates, SOPs, and operational documentation so the team can work more efficiently and consistently.

jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
PagerDuty (NYSE:PD) is a leader in Digital Operations Management. In an always\-on world, organizations of all sizes trust PagerDuty to help them deliver a perfect digital experience to their customers, every time. Teams use PagerDuty to identify issues and opportunities in real time and bring together the right people to fix problems faster and prevent them in the future. Over 13,000 organizations (including 60 of Fortune 100\) rely on PagerDuty to succeed with Digital Transformation, Cloud Migration, and DevOps Modernization. Notable customers include GE, Cisco, Genentech, Electronic Arts, Cox Automotive, Netflix, Shopify, Zoom, DoorDash, Lululemon and more. We are expanding rapidly as a platform for Digital Operations Management using AI/ML and Automation and growing our adoption by Development, IT, Customer Service, Security, and other teams across the organization.

**Event Marketing Manager**

  


**Role Overview**:



PagerDuty is seeking an Event Marketing Manager to join our diverse, customer\-focused team! This role will report directly to the Director of Event Marketing for North America within the Revenue Marketing \& Operations department. As the Event Marketing Manager, you will be a strategic thinker with excellent project management skills, leading the planning and execution of both PagerDuty hosted and 3rd party sponsored events. You will be responsible for developing our event and trade show strategy to ensure alignment with PagerDuty's OKRs, and have a proven track record of successfully partnering with GTM teams to achieve revenue\-based goals through integrated event programs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in planning and executing both small and large\-scale events that contribute to pipeline creation, expand customer acquisition, and grow the PagerDuty brand.

  


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**:


* Develop and implement comprehensive event and trade show strategies aligned with the company's marketing and business objectives.
* Oversee the planning and execution of event programs across both hosted and 3rd party sponsored events, including logistics, vendor management, staffing, and on\-site management
* Collaborate with cross\-functional marketing, sales, and product teams to align on event objectives and create impactful experiences.
* Source and manage vendor and agency relationships as it pertains to event planning and execution: vendors, venues, booth partners, design, video, and more
* Develop enablement tools and resources to empower Sales and Customer Success teams to hit registration targets and achieve executive meeting goals
* Monitor and evaluate event performance against key metrics, collecting and analyzing data to measure success and identify areas for improvement.
* Communicate event plans, progress, and outcomes to senior management and key stakeholders.

  


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**


* At least 7 years of previous experience in a marketing, sales, or customer\-facing role within a fast\-growing organization
* 5\+ years experience in B2B event management with proven experience leading, project managing, and executing large multi\-faceted events
* A data\-driven approach to decision\-making utilizing Salesforce, Tableau, or similar tools

  


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Incredible organization and project management skills to manage multiple events tasks, vendors, and stakeholders simultaneously
* Clear and effective communication skills to interface with team members, stakeholders, vendors, and attendees.
* Ability to build strong cross\-functional relationships and rally project teams.
* Demonstrated ability to set strategic direction, including evaluation of event performance against key metrics for learnings and optimization
* Proficiency in G\-Suite, Salesforce, Tableau, Splash, Cvent, Asana, or Monday
* Experience managing budgets and forecasting spend
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment
* Strong negotiation skills and experience managing vendor relationships and contracts
  


**SALARY RANGE:** $127,000 to $191,4000

**Hesitant to apply?**



We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn't the right role or time \- sign up for job alerts!


**Where we work**



PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we **cannot** employ candidates residing in:


**Location restrictions:**  

**Australia:** Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia  

**Canada:** Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon  

**United States:** Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming  

*Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.*


**How we work**



Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.



People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

Hornblower Group is a global leader in experience and transportation. Spanning a 100\-year history, Hornblower Group’s portfolio of international offerings includes water\- and land\-based experiences and ferry and transportation services. City Experiences, Hornblower Group’s premier experience division, offers dining and sightseeing cruises and walking and food tours through the City Cruises, Walks, and Devour brands. City Ferry, part of Hornblower Group’s Ferry and Transportation Division, is the largest private operator of high\-speed passenger and vehicle ferries in the United States, carrying more than 10 million passengers annually and operating services including NYC Ferry, Puerto Rico Ferry, and other regional ferry systems. Hornblower Group’s subsidiaries include Hornblower Marine, which provides vessel outhaul and maintenance services at Bridgeport Boatworks in Bridgeport, Connecticut, and Seaward Services, Inc., a full\-service shipping, waterfront logistics and management company that specializes in the operation and maintenance of government and commercial vessels. Additionally, Anchor Operating System, LLC, a Hornblower Group subsidiary and independent entity, provides reservation, ticketing and website integration services for clients in the transportation, tourism and entertainment industries. Today, Hornblower Group’s global portfolio covers over 10 countries, over 50 U.S. cities and serves more than 20 million guests annually. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, Hornblower Group’s additional corporate offices reside in San Francisco, California; Boston, Massachusetts; Chicago, Illinois; London, United Kingdom; New York, New York; Dublin, Ireland; and across Ontario, Canada. jobs.title: E-commerce Account Manager
jobs.description:
Verenigde Staten
San Francisco
As E\-commerce Account Manager, you are responsible for the day\-to\-day management and growth of our U.S. E\-commerce business, encompassing Amazon, Walmart, and other retail platforms. You will achieve commercial goals by ensuring content optimization, excellent campaign execution, and sales\-driving activities that are fully aligned with our brand strategy and customer needs. Reporting to the Head of Sales Natural Foods, you are a key member of the U.S. Sales Team, collaborating closely with marketing, category, and global eCommerce colleagues to accelerate our digital growth. Taking full ownership of Paid Search, DSP, Digital Shelf management, pricing, and portal operations, the Account Manager will ensure strategies are tailored to each platform, executed with precision, and aligned with Lotus’s overall business objectives. This role combines strategic and operational responsibilities to optimize the company’s digital presence, enhance brand visibility, and drive revenue growth. You will own platform health, oversee retail media planning, and translate insights into actionable strategies that drive revenue, expand distribution, and increase market share.
  
### **Functiebeschrijving**

Daily Operations \& Platform Management:* Lead daily e\-commerce operations across Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Target, Thrive, Safeway, and Kroger platforms.
* Conduct content and PDP audits, and manage Brand Store updates.
* Maintain scorecards, and pacing tools (including MTD pacing, weekly order review, forecast, and finance check\-ins).


Commercial Planning \& Financial Management:* Collaborate on promotional planning and ensure strong execution
* Support trade spend tracking, true\-ups, and TPM checkbook analysis.
* Own account forecasting and operational troubleshooting in close partnership with the supply chain team


Paid Media \& Advertising:* Partner with internal teams and external agencies (e.g., Tinuiti, Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Costco, Target) to plan, launch, and optimize paid search, DSP, and retail media campaigns.
* Manage media planning and strategy (annual/monthly plans, ROAS targets, budget splits, ecommerce scorecard).
* Execute campaign setup and launch across platforms.
* Perform optimization and bid management (keyword targeting, budget reallocation, ACoS goals).
* Leverage Amazon Marketing Cloud for insights and advanced targeting (audience testing).
* Conduct search terms analysis for trends and insights applicable to paid search strategy.
* Review Amazon AMS spend pacing and adjust strategy as needed.
* Perform paid search campaign optimization for Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Costco, Thrive, and Target.
* Review DSP ads and conduct pulse checks.


Reporting, Insights \& Communication:* Prepare and deliver weekly, monthly, and global business recaps.
* Provide detailed performance insights, visualizations, and actionable recommendations.
* Conduct competitive benchmarking (SOV, media trends, category performance).
* Communicate campaign impact and partner with internal teams and stakeholders.
* Refresh monthly Amazon Ads and Walmart Ads performance recaps for global connects.


Strategy \& Innovation:* Pilot new retail media formats and explore beta features.
* Develop audience strategies using 1P/retailer data.
* Support A/B testing (creative tests, placements tests, dayparting).
* Analyze search term reports, category trends, and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities and inform content, pricing, and media strategies.


Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Relationships:* Coordinate with brand (global/local), insights, and category teams for media plan alignment.
* Work cross\-functionally with marketing and creative to request content updates for key seasons, new item launches, and ad hoc as needed.
* Build strong relationships with platform partners ensuring deliverables and opportunities are leveraged.
### **Profiel**

* Proven experience (4\-6 years) in e\-commerce account management, with a track record of managing multiple accounts and platforms ideally within CPG
* Expertise in e\-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, and Costco, with advanced knowledge of Paid Search, DSP, Digital Shelf management, penalties, and pricing.
* Strong analytical skills to assess campaign performance and make data\-driven decisions.
* Demonstrated success in managing cross\-platform advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns for performance.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Proficiency in Excel or similar tools for reporting and data analysis.
* Proven ability to optimize product listings and manage compliance responsibilities on Amazon.

  
### **Aanbod**

To be determined.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Electronics Tech Industry
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**  

We're a specialized provider of high\-precision electronic calibration and measurement services, is seeking a detail\-oriented, highly articulate Account Manager to join their close\-knit team of 10 in the Bay Area.  

This is primarily an inside sales, account administration, and relationship\-maintenance role—not a cold\-calling or heavy prospecting role. You will serve as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts, ensuring seamless service coordination, accurate scheduling, and exceptionally high\-quality customer communication.  


  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**  

**• Account Management \& Retention:** Act as the lead point of contact for assigned clients. Build long\-term, trusting relationships through warm, proactive, and clear communication.  

**• Service Coordination \& Scheduling:** Coordinate annual and ad\-hoc service schedules for on\-site visits and in\-house lab work. Earn commissions on booked service schedules.  

**• Substantive Client Engagement:** Deliver detailed, helpful, and thorough communication via phone and email (going beyond brief, transactional responses to truly answer client needs).  

**• Administrative \& Sales Support:** Maintain accurate CRM records (Salesforce), generate pricing quotes, compile equipment lists, and support internal sales operations on back\-end retention efforts.  

**• Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with off\-site service technicians, sales managers, and company leadership to maintain high customer satisfaction metrics and fast turnaround times.  


  

**WHAT WE NEED**  

**• Experience:** 3\+ years in account management, customer success, or sales support—preferably within electronics, calibration, manufacturing, or a related technical environment.  

**• Communication Skills:** Outstanding written and verbal skills. Ability to draft articulate, comprehensive, and warm emails that reflect a customer\-first brand tone.  

**• Technical Mindset:** Comfortable using CRMs (Salesforce preferred), MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), and quickly learning technical product/service terminology.  

**• Organizational Mastery:** Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple account schedules independently without daily supervision.  

**• Location:** Local to the Bay Area with full\-time, 100% on\-site availability at the Northern California facility.  


  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**  

**•** Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Sales, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and hands\-on experience).  


  

**WHAT WE OFFER**  

**• Base Salary:** $100,000 – $110,000 depending on experience.  

**• Incentive Compensation:** Monthly performance bonuses (focused on retention and scheduling) \+ Annual commission for organic account expansion/new business.  

**• Benefits:** Comprehensive Health, Vision, and 401(k) retirement plan.  

**• Career Growth:** Opportunities for professional advancement as the team and business expand.

* Healthcare benefits

* Paid vacation and sick leave

* Company\-paid cell phone and laptop

* **Communication:** Maintain frequent, transparent communication with the account team regarding workload status and any issues.

* **Policy Compliance:** Stay updated on company policies and procedures.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Seek and adopt best practices to improve individual and team performance.
* **Champion IOA Values:** Demonstrate integrity and leadership.
  

  

**Ideal Candidate** **Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years of account management experience, or 5\+ years in the insurance industry
* Thorough knowledge of insurance brokerage and client needs
* Required active licensing; professional designation (CIC or equivalent) preferred

* Competitive salaries and bonus potential

* Community service commitment

jobs.title: Specialist Strategy & Sales Operations Lead, Specialist Strategy & Sales Operations
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Application deadline: Sep 2, 2026  

  

AWS is seeking a Specialist Strategy \& Sales Operations Lead, to drive data\-driven decision\-making and operational excellence for the AWS Specialist and Partner organization, focused on the Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). As a strategic business partner to ASP leadership, the Sales Operations Lead serves as a trusted advisor who translates complex data into actionable insights, drives operational excellence, and shapes the strategic direction of sales initiatives through deep business acumen and consultative partnership.
  

  

This role is crucial in leading and scaling mission\-critical frameworks, including territories and quota, goal setting, key initiatives, business reviews, forecasting, and data analysis, to inform strategic recommendations in a rapidly growing, complex environment. Serving as a strategy partner to ASP leadership, the Sales Operations Lead develops, implements, and manages sales processes, systems, and metrics to help the ASP Go\-to\-Market team and those involved in the sales process to increase revenue growth and customer acquisition. Proactively analyzes sales performance data and customer dynamics to identify growth opportunities and provide forward\-looking strategic recommendations to leadership. Partners with stakeholders to achieve day\-to\-day operational excellence through sales process management, performance analysis, technology support, business reviews, operational planning, and communicating actionable insights, both verbally and in writing, while fostering strong stakeholder relationships.
  

  

As the AI\-powered sales landscape continues to evolve, this role will be instrumental in leveraging the latest artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to enhance sales processes and decision\-making, ensuring responsible implementation that drives measurable business impact. The Sales Operations Lead will work closely with ASP leadership and cross\-functional teams to responsibly implement and optimize AI\-driven tools and workflows that augment the sales organization's productivity and effectiveness. This role requires a strategic thinker who can balance operational rigor with consultative partnership, translating data into business strategy while building trusted relationships across all levels of the organization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Documents and implements standardized sales processes and metrics, including KPI definitions and goal cascades, to support operational effectiveness. This may include determining sales territories and quotas for sales teams.  

2\. Develops and manages pipeline qualification, attribution, to ensure proper distribution, and resolves attribution escalations to ensure accurate financial reporting.
  

3\. Orchestrates AI\-human collaboration in the sales process, and manages and optimizes AI sales intelligence tools and automated customer/partner interaction systems
  

4\. Maintains sales tools data quality to ensure accurate reporting and forecasting
  

5\. Implements sales workflows and automation to streamline process and improve seller efficiency
  

6\. Conducts sales performance analysis on win/loss data, conversion rates, goal attainment, and/or forecast accuracy to identify potential risks.
  

7\. Prepares and drives regular business reviews with insights on pipeline health, performance trends, and operational efficiency.
  

8\. Acts as primary point of contact to resolve stakeholders’ requests and execute daily operational processes.
  

9\. Leads sales tools training and adoption initiatives to improve utilization and productivity.
  

10\. Leads cross\-functional projects to improve sales efficiency and processes.
  

11\. Drives escalations, gap\-to\-green, and/or other issues to resolution.  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  

  

About Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)  

  

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.

------------------------

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
TIMEPROOFUSA was founded by some of the home remodeling industry's most respected leaders. We have quickly become America's fastest\-growing home improvement company—providing roofing solutions to homeowners across the country. Our rapid growth is driven by one mission: to deliver uncompromising quality, dependable service, and lasting peace of mind to every customer we serve.



As an Outside Sales Representative, you'll run pre\-set, qualified appointments, educate homeowners on our roofing solutions, and close projects in\-home.


**$4,000 SIGN\-ON BONUS**


**What You'll Do**


* Run pre\-set, qualified appointments with homeowners—no cold calling or lead generation required.
* Conduct professional roofing consultations, product demos, provide same\-day estimates, and close the sale.
* Partner with your Sales Manager and team for ongoing coaching, joint appointments, weekly meetings, and skill development.


**What's In It for You**


* 100% commission W\-2 role with uncapped earnings \+ monthly bonuses.
* On target earnings between $150K–$320K\+ annually.
* Pre\-set qualified leads—focus on closing, not prospecting.
* 4 weeks paid training at $1,000/week, plus earn full commission — not a draw.
* Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k).
* $4,000 Sign\-On Bonus.
* Monthly car allowance
* Cell phone allowance \& company provided iPad


**What It Takes To Succeed**


* Resilience and ability to handle rejection without being discouraged.
* Ability to drive 100 miles a day on average.
* Availability to work evenings and weekends.
* Comfortable working in a commission\-based role.
* Strong ability to navigate complex conversations and close deals on the spot.
* Technological proficiency in using an iPad.
* Submit to a background screening.
* Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.


**More About TIMEPROOFUSA**



TIMEPROOFUSA is redefining the future of roofing. With fire\-safe materials, sustainable technology, and a leadership team backed by decades of success in home remodeling, we're building smarter, safer homes that stand the test of time.



Our core values—People First, Innovation, Customer Obsession, Integrity \& Craftsmanship, and Profit Fuels Our Future—aren't just words on a wall. They drive how we build, lead, and win together.



If you're the kind of person who thrives on challenge, takes pride in excellence, and wants to be part of a team that's changing the industry, this is your moment.



Apply today, take the next step in your career, and let's build something extraordinary together.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Associate, Office of the CEO
jobs.description:
**About Distyl AI**
===================

Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.  

  

We research and deploy technologies that power AI\-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self\-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission\-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.  

  

Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board\-members of 20\+ F500s.


**Why This Role Exists**
------------------------


Distyl’s CEO operates at a fast pace across Fortune 500 customers, investors, board members, candidates, partners, and the press, often across multiple cities in the same week. Keeping that work moving requires someone who can manage critical details while also solving unfamiliar problems with speed and judgment.


This role is equal parts executive support and business problem\-solving. You will coordinate complex logistics, manage priorities, build relationships, and take ambiguous requests from idea to completion. You will not simply manage activity around the CEO; you will help the entire operation run better.


This is an opportunity for an ambitious professional to learn how a high\-growth AI company is built from inside the Office of the CEO. You will receive significant exposure and you will earn increasing responsibility by executing exceptionally well, demonstrating sound judgment, and consistently taking work off the CEO’s plate.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Turn requests into outcomes.** Take ownership of unfamiliar, multi\-step needs—whether securing an urgent international visa, preparing for an important meeting, researching a business question, or coordinating a strategic project. Determine the path forward, involve the right people, and drive the work to completion.

**Create leverage for the CEO.** Manage scheduling, travel, meeting preparation, personal logistics, and follow\-up with precision. Maintain a clear view of priorities and commitments so important details do not get dropped.

**Deliver exceptional external experiences.** Ensure that candidates, customers, investors, board members, and partners experience thoughtful communication and flawless coordination. When plans change, respond calmly and protect both the relationship and the CEO’s time.

**Help develop important relationships.** Research stakeholders, identify paths to valuable introductions, coordinate thoughtful outreach, and follow up persistently. Learn when to keep pursuing an objective, when to try a different approach, and when to recommend moving on.

**Strengthen the Office of the CEO.** Create trackers, workflows, briefing materials, daily priority summaries, meeting\-preparation standards, and follow\-up systems. Identify recurring friction and build a better process.

**Work across the company.** Coordinate with founders’ associates, executives, employees, and external vendors. Communicate clearly, establish ownership, and keep projects moving even when no one reports directly to you.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* A recent graduate or professional with approximately 0–3 years of experience.
* A strong record of academic, professional, entrepreneurial, or extracurricular achievement.
* High agency and resourcefulness, you try multiple paths to solve a problem rather than dropping the task when the first approach fails.
* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* The judgment to handle confidential information and interact professionally with senior executives.
* Comfort moving between strategic projects and hands\-on logistics without viewing either as beneath you.
* Intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn unfamiliar subjects quickly.
* A low\-ego, service\-oriented approach combined with ambition and a desire to grow.
* Comfort operating in an environment where priorities move quickly and the playbook is still being written.
* Fluency with AI tools and an instinct for using technology to improve your work.
* Ability to work from our San Francisco office.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* The CEO spends more time on the company’s highest\-value priorities.
* Important commitments and follow\-ups are completed without reminders.
* Complex logistics run smoothly, even when plans change.
* Stakeholders experience Distyl as thoughtful, responsive, and exceptionally well organized.
* Ambiguous requests become completed outcomes.
* The systems supporting the Office of the CEO become increasingly proactive and scalable.
* As trust develops, you take ownership of progressively broader projects and responsibilities.

**Why This Opportunity Is Different**
-------------------------------------


This is not a conventional Executive Assistant position, nor is it a purely strategic role. It is a hands\-on opportunity for someone who wants direct exposure to the decisions, relationships, and operating challenges behind a rapidly growing AI company.


The right person will be equally willing to solve an urgent travel problem, prepare the CEO for a consequential meeting, improve an internal system, or drive a cross\-functional project. No task is too small when it creates leverage, and no problem is too ambiguous to begin solving.

**What We Offer**
=================

* The base salary range for this role is $100K\

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**

  

ElevenLabs moves fast \- and behind every high\-performing leader is someone who makes sure nothing slips. This is a high\-trust, hands\-on role for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, holds themselves to a high standard, and takes genuine pride in making their lead's life easier \- down to the small, considered details that others overlook.

  

You'll be the operational backbone for senior leadership \- managing calendars, coordinating across time zones, handling logistics, and owning the day\-to\-day administrative tasks that let leadership focus on what matters most.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own calendars and time allocation for finance leadership team, making trade\-off calls independently against stated priorities
* Prepare executives for every meeting: pre\-reads, context, and the decision needed \- including board and investor sessions
* Capture actions out of meetings and chase them to completion
* Triage executive inboxes and draft correspondence
* Automate the mechanical parts of the role \- briefing prep, triage, scheduling, recurring reporting
* Run discrete projects: board logistics, executive travel, offsites, and the finance team's operating cadence

**Requirements**

* Experience supporting multiple senior executives in a high\-velocity environment
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, shifting timelines, and multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from senior executives and partners to vendors and office guests
* Proven judgment and problem\-solving skills
* Fluency with AI tools and a track record of automating your own work \- come ready to show what you've built
* High emotional intelligence and discretion \- trusted with sensitive information
* Fluency in English

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: E-Commerce Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Brooklyn, NY  

**Schedule:** Full\-time, on\-site \| Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  

**Salary:** $60,000–$70,000  

**Reports to:** Director of E\-Commerce Operations

**The Role**
------------


We are looking for an organized, analytical, and dependable **E\-Commerce Operations Coordinator** to support our growing e\-commerce business across Amazon (1P), Walmart, Target\+, Wayfair, and other major marketplaces.


This is an entry\-level role with the opportunity to grow into meaningful responsibility. You will help manage projects, product listings, reporting, inventory, and cross\-team follow\-up. We will train the right person, but we expect strong attention to detail, a willingness to learn, and consistent ownership.


You’ll get a front\-row view of what it takes to operate a nine\-figure e\-commerce business and gain hands\-on experience with the systems, processes, and teams that keep it running behind the scenes.


For someone who is early in their career and interested in e\-commerce, operations, analytics, or marketplace management, this is an opportunity to learn the business from the ground up while working directly with an experienced e\-commerce team.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Track projects, deadlines, action items, and follow\-ups across internal and overseas teams.
* Create, update, and maintain accurate product listings across multiple e\-commerce marketplaces.
* Review product pricing, images, descriptions, specifications, and other listing information for accuracy.
* Analyze sales, inventory, and product performance reports to help identify trends and potential issues.
* Support inventory planning and help ensure appropriate product availability across marketplaces.
* Assist with new product launches and marketplace setup.
* Maintain spreadsheets, reports, trackers, and process documentation.
* Research listing, inventory, pricing, and operational issues and help coordinate solutions.
* Communicate updates and follow up with team members to keep projects moving.
* Help identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and day\-to\-day e\-commerce operations.
* Support the Director of E\-Commerce Operations with additional projects and initiatives as needed.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.
* Analytical and comfortable working with numbers, data, and spreadsheets.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Reliable, proactive, and able to follow through on assignments.
* Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working and communicating with multiple teams.
* Quick to learn new systems, processes, and technology.
* Able to research problems, think critically, and work toward solutions.
* Comfortable working independently while also collaborating as part of a team.

**Experience**
--------------


Previous e\-commerce or marketplace experience is helpful, but **not required**.


Experience with Amazon Vendor Central, Walmart, Target\+, Wayfair, or similar platforms is a plus, but we are willing to train someone who demonstrates strong organizational skills, analytical ability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

**Who Will Succeed in This Role?**
----------------------------------


This position is a great fit for someone who is early in their career and wants more than just a traditional entry\-level job. You may not know everything about e\-commerce yet—and that's okay.


We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out, notices when something doesn't look right, follows through without needing constant reminders, and isn't afraid to ask questions and learn.


As you develop your knowledge of our marketplaces, products, systems, and operations, you'll have the opportunity to take on greater ownership and broader operational responsibility.


If you're organized, curious, comfortable with data, and excited to learn how a large e\-commerce business operates behind the scenes, we'd love to hear from you.

### **About Veho**

  

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone.

  

We are building a modern, end\-to\-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever\-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers.  



Powered by next\-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post\-purchase experience. We make delivery the ‘extension of the brand’ and leverage it to create deeper loyalty and trust between brands and their customers, driving customer retention and lifetime value. jobs.title: Specialist Strategy & Sales Operations Lead, Specialist Strategy & Sales Operations
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Application deadline: Sep 2, 2026  

  

AWS is seeking a Specialist Strategy \& Sales Operations Lead, to drive data\-driven decision\-making and operational excellence for the AWS Specialist and Partner organization, focused on the Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). As a strategic business partner to ASP leadership, the Sales Operations Lead serves as a trusted advisor who translates complex data into actionable insights, drives operational excellence, and shapes the strategic direction of sales initiatives through deep business acumen and consultative partnership.
  

  

This role is crucial in leading and scaling mission\-critical frameworks, including territories and quota, goal setting, key initiatives, business reviews, forecasting, and data analysis, to inform strategic recommendations in a rapidly growing, complex environment. Serving as a strategy partner to ASP leadership, the Sales Operations Lead develops, implements, and manages sales processes, systems, and metrics to help the ASP Go\-to\-Market team and those involved in the sales process to increase revenue growth and customer acquisition. Proactively analyzes sales performance data and customer dynamics to identify growth opportunities and provide forward\-looking strategic recommendations to leadership. Partners with stakeholders to achieve day\-to\-day operational excellence through sales process management, performance analysis, technology support, business reviews, operational planning, and communicating actionable insights, both verbally and in writing, while fostering strong stakeholder relationships.
  

  

As the AI\-powered sales landscape continues to evolve, this role will be instrumental in leveraging the latest artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to enhance sales processes and decision\-making, ensuring responsible implementation that drives measurable business impact. The Sales Operations Lead will work closely with ASP leadership and cross\-functional teams to responsibly implement and optimize AI\-driven tools and workflows that augment the sales organization's productivity and effectiveness. This role requires a strategic thinker who can balance operational rigor with consultative partnership, translating data into business strategy while building trusted relationships across all levels of the organization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Documents and implements standardized sales processes and metrics, including KPI definitions and goal cascades, to support operational effectiveness. This may include determining sales territories and quotas for sales teams.  

2\. Develops and manages pipeline qualification, attribution, to ensure proper distribution, and resolves attribution escalations to ensure accurate financial reporting.
  

3\. Orchestrates AI\-human collaboration in the sales process, and manages and optimizes AI sales intelligence tools and automated customer/partner interaction systems
  

4\. Maintains sales tools data quality to ensure accurate reporting and forecasting
  

5\. Implements sales workflows and automation to streamline process and improve seller efficiency
  

6\. Conducts sales performance analysis on win/loss data, conversion rates, goal attainment, and/or forecast accuracy to identify potential risks.
  

7\. Prepares and drives regular business reviews with insights on pipeline health, performance trends, and operational efficiency.
  

8\. Acts as primary point of contact to resolve stakeholders’ requests and execute daily operational processes.
  

9\. Leads sales tools training and adoption initiatives to improve utilization and productivity.
  

10\. Leads cross\-functional projects to improve sales efficiency and processes.
  

11\. Drives escalations, gap\-to\-green, and/or other issues to resolution.  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  

  

About Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)  

  

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.

jobs.title: Part-Time Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**


Key Responsibilities

### **Digital Marketing Strategy \& Program Messaging**

* Develop and refine messaging frameworks for CPE programs and new program launches.
* Translate program differentiators and value propositions into compelling messaging for websites, email campaigns, social media, digital advertising, and partner outreach.
* Identify opportunities to improve CPE’s digital visibility, prospective student engagement, and conversion.
* Develop actionable short\-term marketing priorities capable of producing measurable impact during the six\-month appointment.

### **Social Media \& Audience Growth**

* Develop and execute a strategy to significantly strengthen CPE’s LinkedIn presence and organic social engagement.
* Build an effective content calendar featuring programs, faculty expertise, student and alumni outcomes, industry partnerships, events, and thought leadership.
* Test content formats, messaging, posting strategies, and calls to action to determine what drives meaningful audience growth and engagement.
* Establish benchmarks and track growth in followers, reach, engagement, website traffic, and lead generation attributable to organic social media.

### **SEO, AEO \& Content Strategy**

* Develop an SEO/AEO content strategy to improve CPE’s organic search visibility and presence in AI\-powered search and answer engines.
* Identify high\-value topics, keywords, questions, and content opportunities related to CPE programs and target audiences.
* Optimize existing and new website and editorial content for traditional search engines and emerging AI discovery channels.
* Develop campaign and content pillars that support sustainable organic audience growth.

### **Email \& Prospective Student Engagement**

* Develop and execute targeted email communications for inquiries, RFIs, application starts, and other prospective student populations using Slate.
* Evaluate email performance and recommend improvements to messaging, segmentation, timing, calls to action, and conversion strategies.
* Coordinate CPE communications with existing external partner recruitment and nurture campaigns.

### **Paid \& Partner Marketing**

* Collaborate with external enrollment marketing partners on messaging, creative direction, audience strategy, and performance of paid campaigns across digital channels and performance of paid campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, and other appropriate channels.
* Review campaign results and recommend adjustments based on performance data.
* Identify opportunities to test additional channels or campaigns when supported by audience and performance data.
* Coordinate with Stevens marketing resources and external partners as appropriate.

### **Analytics, Reporting \& Optimization**

* Establish clear performance benchmarks and KPIs for CPE’s digital marketing activities.
* Maintain and enhance marketing dashboards and reporting.
* Analyze website traffic, engagement, inquiries, application starts, enrollment funnel activity, email performance, organic search, social media, and campaign results.
* Translate data into actionable recommendations rather than reporting metrics alone.
* Provide regular updates on progress, results, opportunities, and recommended next steps.

------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, digital media, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of progressively responsible digital marketing experience, preferably including higher education, professional education, B2B, or other lead\-generation environments.
