jobs.description:
**POSITION**

The Program Specialist, Accessibility Services, supports the Chicago Housing Authority’s (CHA) centralized administration of reasonable accommodation requests for residents and applicants with disabilities. Under the direction of the Manager, Accessibility the Specialist serves as the primary intake and coordination with our service providers for reasonable accommodation requests, ensuring that all submissions are reviewed, verified, documented, and completed in accordance with Section 504, ADA, FHA, and CHA policy. This role requires a high level of attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to guide residents, applicants, and property staff through the reasonable accommodation process with clarity, patience, and professionalism. The Specialist also contributes to broader Accessibility Services initiatives, including data tracking, resident support, and cross\-department collaboration.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


* Serve as the primary intake point for reasonable accommodation (RA) requests from public housing residents and applicants, ensuring timely review and processing.
* Complete assigned RA requests, including review of documentation, case notes, determination letters, resident notifications, and coordination with Service Providers, Property Management and other CHA departments.
* Conduct on ‑ site reasonable accommodation or modification assessments as needed to evaluate the feasibility of requested modifications, understand resident needs, and coordinate with Property Management and Maintenance teams.
* Ensure all RA determinations, correspondence, and supporting documentation are accurately recorded in YARDI and communicated to residents, applicants, and third\-party contractor staff. Prepare RA documentation and recommendations for approval chain.
* Communicate with residents and applicants regarding the status of their accommodation request, explaining processes, policies, and next steps in clear and accessible language.
* Coordinate implementation of approved accommodations with Property Management, Maintenance, Property Office/Occupancy, and other CHA partners.
* Participate in the interactive process when additional information, clarification, or consultation is required.
* Support special projects related to accessibility compliance, resident engagement, and quality\-of\-life initiatives as assigned.
* Travels to attend off\-site training, meetings, and events, as assigned;
* May be asked to handle tasks outside of job description to meet broader goals of CHA and Resident Services.
* This position requires working hours outside of CHA’s established hours of 8:30am – 5:00pm, Monday\- Friday including weekends.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor’s degree in social work, public administration, disability studies, human development, liberal arts, or a related field, with a strong preference for candidates who have completed a graduate degree in disability studies, special education, public administration, public policy, or a similar discipline. Candidates should have at least one (1\) year of experience working with individuals with disabilities, providing coordination, supporting compliance or resident services, along with a demonstrated passion for public service and a commitment to advocating for people with disabilities. Experience within public housing or other regulated environments is beneficial. This role requires excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex policies in a clear and accessible manner, as well as strong organizational abilities to manage multiple cases and deadlines. Familiarity with disability rights laws such as Section 504, ADA, and the Fair Housing Act, is preferred, and a willingness to develop specialized expertise is essential. Proficiency in Microsoft Office is required, and experience with YARDI or other case management systems is a plus.  

***BENEFITS AT\-A\-GLANCE**** *Vacation, Sick and Personal, competitive PTO package*
* *Medical (HMO, PPO, and No employee cost High\-Deductible PPO) Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance*
* *Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance*
* *Long\-Term Care Insurance*
* *Pet Insurance*
* *Parking Transit*
* *Prepaid Legal Services*
* *Brightstar 529 College Savings Plan*
* *Identity Theft Protection*
* *Hospital Indemnity Insurance*
* *Voluntary Critical Illness Insurance*
* *Deferred Compensation Plan: Empower 457/401(a) with a 3% employer match*
* *Pension Plan: CHA makes contributions on behalf of the employee, along with the employee's 3% contribution; 100% vesting occurs after 6 years of continuous employment or opt\-out of CHA's Retirement Plan and continues to participate in the Municipal Employees Annuity and Benefit Fund of Chicago*
* *Hybrid work schedule (position specific) This position may be eligible for remote work following a successful completion of a 90\-day probationary period according to CHA’s established policies and procedures.*

Salary Range: $60,000 ‐ $65,000
Grade: S7
FLSA: Exempt
Union: None

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
You get to create, execute, and keep the work moving.  

  

Roadrunner is the most tech\-forward company in LTL. We built a proprietary Smart Network™ that delivers fewer touches, faster transit, real\-time visibility, and real accountability. The service is differentiated. The point of view is clear. Marketing has not yet fully translated that advantage into how the brand shows up every day—on the website, in social, in video, in events, and in the materials our teams use.  

  

That’s the opportunity. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you will be the creative force and operational backbone of the marketing team. You will design, film, write, organize, and ship. You will bring campaigns to life through compelling visual content, tight planning, and cross\-platform execution. You will keep initiatives on\-brand, on deadline, and running smoothly in a lean, PE\-backed environment that rewards ownership and speed.
**What you’ll do**
==================

**1\. Content Creation \& Brand Presence**
------------------------------------------


This is a creation role, not a maintenance role. You make the brand visible.

* Design and produce marketing materials using Canva and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) for digital and print campaigns.
* Invent and ship high\-impact visual content that advances Roadrunner as the Category of One—graphics, sales collateral, social assets, landing\-page visuals, event materials, and campaign creative.
* Create video and photo content. Appear on camera when needed and direct shoots that capture authentic customer stories, owner\-operator voices, and company culture.
* Support Roadrunner’s LinkedIn and social presence with content that is sharp, human, and on\-brand—not generic freight marketing.
* Shape how the brand shows up across digital, physical, and experiential touchpoints so every interaction reinforces that Roadrunner is leading the way.

**2\. Campaign Execution \& Coordination**
------------------------------------------


The Marketing Manager owns the strategy. You make the machine run.

* Coordinate with vendors, internal stakeholders, sales, talent acquisition, and the marketing team to execute multi\-channel campaigns on time.
* Support integrated campaigns across digital, social, email, content, events, and emerging channels that drive awareness, pipeline, and talent outcomes.
* Treat every campaign as an experiment. Track what shipped, what worked, and what needs to change. Document what you learn.
* Produce materials and communications for strategic customer accounts based on direction from leadership and the Marketing Manager.

**3\. Website, Social \& Digital Presence**
-------------------------------------------


Keep the public face of the brand fresh, usable, and current.

* Manage and update the website CMS so content is accurate, optimized, and user\-friendly.
* Support social media content creation and campaign execution across platforms—planning, producing, scheduling, and reporting.
* Help build and maintain landing pages and digital experiences that match Roadrunner’s voice and convert attention into action.
* Use AI tools to accelerate production without sacrificing quality, voice, or point of view.

**4\. Calendar, Systems \& Operational Support**
------------------------------------------------


You are the detail\-oriented backbone. Nothing falls through the cracks.

* Own the marketing calendar and project\-management systems. Keep deadlines visible. Keep work moving.
* Help maintain reusable content resources, brand guidelines, and AI prompt frameworks so internal teams can produce on\-brand materials without bottlenecks.
* Apply AI and automation to recurring production and administrative work—reducing manual effort and shortening turnaround time.
* Track marketing expenses and assist with budget reconciliation.
* Identify friction in how marketing work gets done, then fix it with process, templates, and tools that stick.

**5\. Talent, Owner\-Operator \& Culture Content**
--------------------------------------------------


Attract the right people. Help them stay. Make the culture visible.

* Produce recruitment marketing creative that attracts high\-quality CDL drivers, owner operators, and key employees.
* Create targeted assets and content for owner\-operator acquisition and retention campaigns.
* Partner with talent acquisition and operations to support employee recruiting with clear, compelling materials.
* Capture and produce culture content—photos, video, recognition assets, newsletter visuals—that reinforces We Run Safe. We Run Smart. We Run Together.
* Support internal communications with polished, on\-brand assets so employees and owner operators feel informed and seen.

**What you bring**
==================

* Proven experience in a marketing or related creative role, with a portfolio that shows you can make work, not only talk about it.
* Significant creative skill in Canva and comfort in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro).
* Confidence both in front of and behind the camera for video and photography.
* CMS experience and proven website management skills.
* Event marketing experience, especially direct customer engagement and activation.
* Experience creating content for social platforms and running work across multiple channels at once.
* Detail\-oriented process and project\-management muscle. You keep calendars, files, vendors, and deadlines tight.
* Strong writing and visual storytelling. You can make industrial and technology stories feel sharp and human.
* Comfort using AI tools to create, iterate, and scale content without losing quality or brand voice.
* Comfort operating in a lean, fast\-moving environment where you wear multiple hats and invent process as needed.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Great to have: HubSpot or similar marketing automation, Google Analytics,

**Buehler, a division of Illinois Tool Works,** is a leading manufacturer of scientific equipment and supplies for use in material analysis. Over the past 80\+ years, Buehler has established sales, manufacturing and laboratory services located throughout North America, Europe and Asia. Comprised of world\-class products and brands, such as Wilson Hardness, Buehler continues a long history of providing market\-leading technology to support our customers in their sample preparation and material analysis applications.


Buehler’s parent company, ITW, is a Fortune 200 global diversified industrial manufacturer of value\-added consumables and specialty equipment with related service businesses. The Company focuses on profitable growth with strong returns across worldwide platforms and businesses. The businesses serve local customers and markets around the globe, with a significant presence in developed as well as emerging markets.

**Job Responsibilities:**


* Territory Ownership: Strategically manage and grow a dedicated R\&D Inside Sales territory, with a primary focus on education and research and development customers
* Sales Execution: Proactively identify, qualify, and secure new business opportunities for equipment and consumables, driving the entire sales pipeline forward independently.
* Technical Consulting: Act as the primary technical resource for customers, leveraging your expertise to understand client material analysis needs and propose customized product and application solutions.
* Lab Collaboration: Partner closely with the Application Lab team to organize and facilitate remote/virtual product demonstrations and advise customers on the benefits of Buehler's products.
* Field Training: Conduct regular, intentional travel (up to 20%) alongside the Field Sales Representative to gain essential on\-site experience, observe complex sales cycles, installations and build field relationships.
* Forecasting \& Insight: Maintain meticulous records and provide accurate, timely sales forecasts and records using our Microsoft Dynamics CRM
* Account Nurturing: Build and nurture strong, long\-term relationships with key engineering contacts and purchasing teams within your territory with an emphasis on University segment.
* Frontline Communicator: Take inbound sales calls for no less than 1\.5 hours per day to help clients select the best products based on their application.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or equivalent technical field) is strongly preferred.
* At least 2 years of professional experience in technical sales, application engineering, or a customer\-facing technical role.
* Demonstrated ability to articulate complex technical products and value propositions clearly and persuasively.
* Exceptional organizational skills and proven ability to work independently as a self\-starter who manages own schedule with manager guidance
* Proficiency in using Microsoft applications and a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.
* **Must live within the state of Illinois**

**Additional Information:**

* 7\.5% 401K match
* 4 weeks of paid time off
* 10 paid company holidays
* Recognition program
* Competitive health insurance
**Compensation Information:**


The base salary for this position is $70,000 \- 80,000 \+ commissions for those in the Illinois area. Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

*ITW is an equal opportunity employer. We value our colleagues’ unique perspectives, experiences and ideas and create workplaces where everyone can develop their careers and perform to their full potential.*

 *As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.*

new_jobs.description:
#### **ABH Riverside**

#### **Job Summary:**


The Outreach Ambassador – Homeless Services is a dynamic, field\-based role at Weingart Center, a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to ending homelessness in Los Angeles. This position blends community programming with direct outreach to individuals experiencing homelessness. Ambassadors facilitate wellness and educational activities for interim housing residents, while also engaging unhoused individuals in surrounding public areas. They work closely with LAHSA, LA County outreach teams, and site security to connect individuals to housing and support services. The role includes food distribution, documentation, caseload support, and assistance to the Program Manager in daily operations.


#### **Essential Functions:**


Conduct daily outreach in public areas, accompanied by site security, to engage unhoused individuals respectfully and safely



Walk designated routes with a clipboard to document interactions, needs, and housing interest



Complete intakes and assessments, and connect individuals to housing resources through LAHSA and partner agencies



Collaborate with LA County outreach coordinators to coordinate referrals and follow\-ups



Maintain an active caseload of 10–15 individuals, including both interim housing residents and outreach contacts



Conduct regular check\-ins to assess progress, update housing plans, and identify barriers to stability



Track client milestones such as document readiness, housing application status, and service referrals



Develop and lead monthly activity calendars (e.g., workshops, fitness, arts, life skills) for interim housing residents



Promote participation through flyers, announcements, and one\-on\-one engagement



Organize and distribute meals/snacks to residents and outreach contacts



Track food inventory and coordinate with vendors and volunteers for safe delivery



Maintain accurate case notes and documentation in HMIS/Clarity



Assist the Program Manager with administrative tasks, reporting, and coordination



Uphold trauma\-informed, harm\-reduction, and culturally competent practices in all interactions


#### **Required Qualifications:**


High school diploma or equivalent (Associate or Bachelor’s in social work, psychology, or related field preferred)



1–2 years of experience in outreach, social services, or activity coordination



Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage in diverse populations



Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, mental health challenges, or substance use preferred



Must be empathetic, observant, and able to advocate effectively



Food service training or certification required (e.g., ServSafe or equivalent)



CPR/First Aid certification (or willingness to obtain)



Willingness to complete training in Trauma\-Informed Care, De\-escalation, and Harm Reduction


#### **Physical \& Mental Requirements:**


Ability to walk long distances and stand for extended periods while conducting outreach



Capable of lifting up to 25 lbs. and performing physical tasks such as bending, reaching, and carrying supplies



Strong verbal communication, reading, writing, and decision\-making skills



Comfortable working indoors, outdoors, and in diverse urban environments



Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with face\-to\-face and verbal contact


#### **About WEINGART CENTER ASSOCIATION**


As one of the best comprehensive human services organizations in the western United States, Weingart Center is committed to removing barriers that keep people from housing. With multiple Interim and Permanent Supportive Housing solutions throughout the greater Los Angeles area, Weingart Center addresses the needs of seniors, Veterans, women, members of the LGBTQAI\+ community, the formerly incarcerated, and many others experiencing homelessness. All Weingart Center housing solutions include comprehensive wraparound services, which are designed to help clients overcome challenges and clear the way for a fulfilling life.

### **Social Media \& Audience Growth**

* Develop and execute a strategy to significantly strengthen CPE’s LinkedIn presence and organic social engagement.
* Build an effective content calendar featuring programs, faculty expertise, student and alumni outcomes, industry partnerships, events, and thought leadership.
* Test content formats, messaging, posting strategies, and calls to action to determine what drives meaningful audience growth and engagement.

### **SEO, AEO \& Content Strategy**

* Develop an SEO/AEO content strategy to improve CPE’s organic search visibility and presence in AI\-powered search and answer engines.

* Optimize existing and new website and editorial content for traditional search engines and emerging AI discovery channels.
* Develop campaign and content pillars that support sustainable organic audience growth.

### **Email \& Prospective Student Engagement**

* Evaluate email performance and recommend improvements to messaging, segmentation, timing, calls to action, and conversion strategies.
* Coordinate CPE communications with existing external partner recruitment and nurture campaigns.

### **Paid \& Partner Marketing**

* Collaborate with external enrollment marketing partners on messaging, creative direction, audience strategy, and performance of paid campaigns across digital channels and performance of paid campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, and other appropriate channels.
* Review campaign results and recommend adjustments based on performance data.
* Identify opportunities to test additional channels or campaigns when supported by audience and performance data.
* Coordinate with Stevens marketing resources and external partners as appropriate.

### **Analytics, Reporting \& Optimization**

* Establish clear performance benchmarks and KPIs for CPE’s digital marketing activities.
* Maintain and enhance marketing dashboards and reporting.
* Analyze website traffic, engagement, inquiries, application starts, enrollment funnel activity, email performance, organic search, social media, and campaign results.
* Translate data into actionable recommendations rather than reporting metrics alone.
* Provide regular updates on progress, results, opportunities, and recommended next steps.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, digital media, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of progressively responsible digital marketing experience, preferably including higher education, professional education, B2B, or other lead\-generation environments.
* Demonstrated success growing digital audiences and improving engagement and/or conversion.
* Strong experience with LinkedIn and organic social media strategy.
* Working knowledge of SEO and emerging AEO/AI\-search optimization practices.
* Experience with email marketing, audience segmentation, and lifecycle/nurture campaigns.
* Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to use performance data to improve marketing results.
* Experience with web analytics and marketing reporting platforms.
* Excellent writing, editing, messaging, and storytelling skills.
* Ability to operate independently, prioritize high\-impact opportunities, and deliver results within a fast\-moving environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience marketing graduate, continuing education, professional education, or other higher education programs.
* Experience with Slate or another higher education CRM.
* Experience collaborating with external marketing agencies or enrollment partners.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, LinkedIn analytics, paid digital advertising platforms, UTM tracking, and dashboard/reporting tools.
* Experience developing content optimized for both traditional search and AI\-powered discovery.
* Experience launching or repositioning educational programs.

**Measures of Success**
-----------------------


Because this is a six\-month appointment, success will be measured by demonstrated improvement rather than activity alone. Key measures may include:

* Growth in CPE’s LinkedIn audience, reach, and meaningful engagement.
* Increased qualified traffic to CPE program pages.
* Improved organic search and AI\-search visibility.
* Increased prospective student inquiries and engagement.
* Improved conversion of RFIs and application starts.
* Stronger performance of program messaging and digital campaigns.
* Establishment of repeatable marketing processes, content strategies, dashboards, and recommendations that CPE can continue beyond the six\-month appointment.

**Department**


CPE Operations

The UChicago Simulation Center strives to measurably improve the quality, safety, and experience of healthcare delivery through the application of cutting\-edge simulation methods, systems thinking, human\-centered design, and innovative technology. Dedicated to high\-quality simulation, the Simulation Center partners across the University of Chicago Health System and Biological Sciences Division to co\-design and implement simulation\-based programs that promote clinical readiness, skill development, digital innovation, and research. **Job Summary**


The Resuscitation \& Community Outreach Program Manager is an integral member of the team, overseeing the logistics, operations, and continuous improvement of the resuscitation programs serving the health system. This includes basic life support (BLS), Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS), Pediatric Life Support (PALS), Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP), and Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS).
